title: Financial Services Recruiter – Brokerage & Trading Network
description:
Shah Equity

Remote | Contract / Temporary

Referral-Based Compensation



About the Role



Shah Equity is looking for a Financial Services Recruiter with existing contacts or experience in recruiting/referring individuals for brokerage-account, trading, financial-services, or similar representative roles.



This position is specifically for someone who already has connections to people in the United States who have experience with brokerage accounts, authorized representative arrangements, nominee/representative roles, or situations where another party manages trading activity.



You will use your existing professional contacts and network to identify potentially qualified U.S. citizens who may be interested in Shah Equity's opportunities.



What You'll Do

Use your existing professional network to identify potential candidates.

Contact people who may have relevant brokerage, trading, or financial-services experience.

Refer qualified and interested candidates to Shah Equity.

Explain the general opportunity using approved Shah Equity information.

Provide Shah Equity with accurate candidate contact information.

Help connect interested candidates with the appropriate Shah Equity representative.

Maintain communication with Shah Equity regarding your referrals.

Follow Shah Equity's recruiting and referral procedures.

Who We're Looking For



This position is particularly suited for someone who has previously:



Recruited or referred people for brokerage-account-related roles.

Recruited or referred individuals for trading or financial-services positions.

Worked with authorized representatives or similar financial-services arrangements.

Recruited individuals who allowed another authorized party or company to manage trading activity in their brokerage account under a legitimate arrangement.

Worked with nominee, representative, or similar administrative structures.

Has direct contacts with U.S. citizens who have experience in these areas.

Has an established network of financial-services, trading, brokerage, or investment professionals.



Direct experience and established contacts in this area are strongly preferred.



Important



This is a referral/recruiting position, not a trading position.



You will not be responsible for managing brokerage accounts, making trades, managing investments, or providing investment, legal, tax, or financial advice.



All candidates will be contacted and evaluated by Shah Equity before any onboarding takes place.



Recruiters must accurately represent the opportunity and may not make promises or guarantees regarding acceptance, compensation, trading results, or financial outcomes.



Compensation

$300 USD (approximately ₱18,800 PHP) per successful referral/onboarding

Paid weekly

Commission-based; no salary or hourly base pay

Compensation is paid after the referred candidate successfully completes the required onboarding and is verified as a qualifying referral.

No guaranteed earnings.

Requirements

Previous recruiting, referral, sales, networking, or financial-services experience preferred.

Existing professional contacts in the U.S. financial-services or trading community strongly preferred.

Ability to identify potentially qualified candidates.

Strong communication skills.

Ability to follow approved recruiting and referral procedures.

Professional and reliable communication.

title: TIKTOK LIVE CREATOR ACQUISITION MANAGER
description:
TIKTOK LIVE CREATOR ACQUISITION MANAGER



ProMark Media is building a dedicated Philippines Creator Acquisition Division and is looking for an experienced and results-driven TikTok LIVE Creator Acquisition Manager to lead and grow our recruitment team.



You will initially manage a team of 5 TikTok LIVE Creator Acquisition Specialists, with the opportunity to expand the team as performance and business needs grow.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



• Lead, manage, and motivate the Philippines Creator Acquisition team

• Drive daily TikTok LIVE creator prospecting and recruitment

• Coach recruiters on outreach, communication, and conversion strategies

• Set and monitor individual and team KPIs

• Review recruitment pipelines and identify areas for improvement

• Track daily and weekly team performance

• Improve creator outreach and conversion rates

• Ensure recruitment quality, accuracy, and compliance

• Conduct regular team meetings and performance check-ins

• Provide training, guidance, and feedback to recruiters

• Monitor recruiter activity and ensure targets are being followed

• Prepare performance reports for ProMark leadership

• Identify recruitment challenges and implement solutions

• Assist with team expansion and onboarding as the operation grows



REQUIREMENTS



We are looking for someone with experience in one or more of the following:



• TikTok LIVE or Creator Networks

• Livestreaming agencies

• Creator or influencer acquisition

• Recruitment management

• High-volume outbound sales

• Lead generation

• Social media acquisition

• Team leadership or performance management



THE IDEAL CANDIDATE



• Strong leadership and people-management skills

• Excellent written and verbal English

• Comfortable managing a remote team

• Strong communication and coaching abilities

• Highly organized and comfortable working with KPIs and trackers

• Results-driven and accountable

• Able to identify performance issues and provide practical solutions

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced international environment

• Experience managing recruiters, sales representatives, or acquisition teams is highly preferred

• TikTok LIVE or livestreaming industry experience is a strong advantage



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Your main goal will be to build a high-performing creator acquisition team that consistently identifies, engages, and converts qualified TikTok LIVE creators.



You will work closely with ProMark leadership to improve recruitment processes, strengthen team performance, maintain recruitment quality, and help scale our Philippines acquisition operation.



WORK SETUP



🏠 100% Remote

🌎 International operation

📈 Opportunity to help build and scale a growing acquisition division

⚡ Immediate start preferred



Candidates must be available to work full-time and should be able to start within 4 days.



ABOUT PROMARK MEDIA



ProMark Media is an international creator-focused company working with TikTok LIVE creators and digital talent.



We are building a strong Philippines-based acquisition operation focused on identifying quality creators and providing them with professional support as they grow their TikTok LIVE presence.



If you are an experienced team leader who knows how to manage people, drive performance, and build a strong acquisition pipeline, we would love to hear from you.



ProMark Media

Creator Founded. Globally Driven.

title: Short-Form Video Editor — UGC, Overlays & Transitions (HIGH VOLUME 200-300 Videos / Month)
description:
Short-Form Video Editor — UGC, Overlays & Transitions



Location: New York City, NY | Remote Position | Philippines or Similar Time Zone Preferred



We’re looking for a talented short-form video editor to work directly with me on a high-performing social media page. We create content designed to capture attention immediately, maintain viewer retention, and perform exceptionally well on TikTok and Instagram Reels.



This is not a basic video-cutting role. I’m looking for someone who understands how to transform raw footage into polished, engaging UGC videos through creative hooks, high-level overlays, seamless transitions, and professional visual storytelling.



What You’ll Be Doing



Hook optimization: Make the first 1–3 seconds compelling through strong opening cuts, text, visuals, and creative editing that immediately captures attention.



High-level overlays: Incorporate relevant images, screenshots, graphics, headlines, pop-ups, and other visual elements that reinforce the message and keep viewers engaged.



Professional transitions: Create smooth, intentional transitions between clips, images, and scenes. The goal is a polished, dynamic flow—not basic cuts between talking-head footage.



Dynamic editing: Use punch-ins, zooms, reframing, motion effects, speed adjustments, and creative visual techniques to maintain attention.



B-roll and visual storytelling: Understand the dialogue, identify the key points, and pair the audio with relevant supporting footage and imagery.



Retention-focused pacing: Remove dead space, emphasize important moments, and keep the content moving without sacrificing clarity.



Creative independence: Bring your own ideas and editing style to the content while following the general direction and quality standards of the page.



My biggest priorities are hooks, overlays, images, and transitions. I want someone who knows how to make a video feel visually rich, professional, and engaging. Simply adding captions and cutting out pauses is not enough.



Application Process — Required Editing Test



To apply, you must complete the following test. Your three edited videos will be the primary factor in our hiring decision. We want to evaluate the actual quality of your work, not just your résumé or previous experience.



Step 1: Download the Raw Footage



Use the footage linked below to create three separate short-form UGC videos.



Raw footage: 
 



Your goal is to break the footage into three compelling videos, each with its own strong hook, clear narrative, and professional editing.



Pay particular attention to:



Strong opening hooks that immediately grab attention.



Creative, relevant image overlays and on-screen visual elements.



Smooth transitions between footage, images, and scenes.



Dynamic pacing, strategic zooms, and engaging visual changes.



Relevant B-roll and supporting visuals that complement the dialogue.



Overall polish, professionalism, and suitability for TikTok and Instagram Reels.



Step 2: Review My Editing Example




 



Use my edit as a reference for the general direction and quality I’m looking for. However, I also want to see your own professional judgment, creativity, and editing style.



Don't simply copy my video. Show me how you would elevate the content using your own ideas, particularly when it comes to hooks, overlays, transitions, and visual storytelling.



Step 3: Submit Your Application and Videos



CLICK HERE TO APPLY AND UPLOAD YOUR THREE VIDEOS: 
 



Please submit your application and all three completed videos through the form above.



Important: The professionalism and quality of these three videos will be the primary basis of our hiring decision. Take the time to demonstrate what you can do.



Requirements



Strong experience with CapCut or comparable video editing software.



Previous experience editing TikTok videos, Instagram Reels, or short-form UGC content.



Excellent understanding of hooks, overlays, transitions, pacing, and audience retention.



Strong English comprehension and attention to detail.



Ability to independently interpret dialogue and select appropriate supporting visuals.



Strong internet connection and reliable communication.



Ability to work collaboratively, take constructive feedback, and improve quickly.



Availability for approximately 3–4 hours per day, 5–6 days per week. Days off are flexible, provided your schedule remains consistent.



Ability to receive payments through Wise.



Based in the Philippines or a similar time zone.



Compensation & Growth Opportunity



You’ll work directly with me on a high-performing social media page with significant growth potential.



There is room for performance-based bonuses when deadlines are met and content performs well. As the workload grows, there is also potential for additional hours and increased compensation.



I’m looking for someone reliable, creative, and detail-oriented who wants to develop a long-term working relationship and help produce consistently excellent content.



If you believe your editing can stand out, complete the three-video test and show us what you can do.

title: Senior Virtual Assistant
description:
Job Summary



We are looking for a highly organized, proactive and dependable Senior Virtual Assistant to join the core remote team of a Hong Kong-based company.

This is not a basic task-based VA position. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of recurring workflows, work independently, maintain accurate records and ensure responsibilities are completed without repeated follow-up.

You will work across different departments based on company requirements and your strongest skills. Areas may include Operations, Supply Chain, Government Documentation and Administration.



Key Responsibilities



- Own and manage assigned recurring workflows from start to finish.

- Manage deadlines, follow-ups and recurring tasks independently.

- Maintain accurate ClickUp tasks, spreadsheets, records and documentation.

- Create, maintain and improve SOPs and working processes.

- Check your own work for accuracy before completion.

- Identify problems, missing information and process gaps early.

- Escalate issues before they become failures.

- Coordinate with team members, suppliers and external parties when required.

- Support and guide Junior Virtual Assistants on workflows within your responsibility.

- Conduct research and turn findings into clear actions or recommendations.

- Support cross-department projects and operational requirements.

- Depending on your primary area, work may include:

- Supply Chain & Operations: supplier communication, purchase orders, shipments, inventory records, product information, price lists, spreadsheets and coordination between departments.

- Government & Operations: vehicle registration documentation, applications, document preparation, tracking, deadlines, record keeping and operational support.

- Responsibilities may shift between departments based on workload, company priorities and individual strengths.



What We Expect



- Ownership: If something is assigned to you, you follow it through to completion.

- Accuracy: Management should not need to repeatedly find and correct mistakes.

- Follow-through: You close loops without being chased.

- Early escalation: If something is blocked, unclear or at risk, you raise it early.

- Process improvement: If something repeatedly does not work, you identify the problem and suggest a better way.

- Adaptability: You are comfortable learning new responsibilities and working across departments.



Qualifications & Skills



Strong written and spoken English.

Excellent organization, accuracy and attention to detail.

Strong follow-up and time-management skills.

Experience working independently in a remote environment.

Experience managing recurring workflows or administrative processes.

Strong documentation and SOP-writing ability.

Comfortable with spreadsheets and structured data.

Experience with ClickUp or similar project-management software.

Comfortable using modern AI tools for work and research.

Able to learn unfamiliar systems and processes quickly.

Able to manage multiple priorities without constant supervision.

Experience in operations, supply chain, logistics, government documentation, inventory or administration is an advantage but not required.

We value ownership, learning ability and reliability more than experience in an identical industry.



How Success Is Measured



Success means your workflows run accurately and on time, records stay updated, problems are raised early, and management does not need to repeatedly remind you or check your work.

title: Senior Bookkeeper & Administrative Assistant
description:
Job Summary



We are looking for an experienced, highly accurate and dependable Senior Bookkeeper & Administrative Assistant to support multiple companies within our group.

Your primary responsibility will be Finance and Bookkeeping, ensuring our financial records are accurate, current and properly reconciled.

As part of a small cross-functional team, you will also support HR administration, compliance, contracts, legal documentation and general company administration when required.

This role requires someone who can take ownership of recurring finance workflows, identify discrepancies independently and ensure issues are resolved without repeated management follow-up.



Key Responsibilities



Finance & Bookkeeping

Maintain accurate day-to-day bookkeeping across multiple companies.

Record and correctly categorize income, expenses, accounts payable and accounts receivable.

Perform bank, payment account and balance reconciliations.

Maintain accurate general ledger records in Xero.

Prepare monthly Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow reports.

Review financial records for missing entries, incorrect classifications and discrepancies.

Maintain supporting documents, invoices, receipts and financial records.

Assist with payroll preparation and employee payment records.

Coordinate financial information required by accountants, auditors, banks and other external parties.

Support inventory and purchase reconciliation with the Supply Chain team.

Maintain and improve bookkeeping SOPs, checklists and recurring finance workflows.

HR, Legal & Administration

Maintain employee records, contracts and HR documentation.

Support onboarding, offboarding and recurring HR administration.

Track important company, contract, insurance, licence and compliance deadlines.

Prepare and organize documents for management, external accountants, lawyers and other professional service providers.

Follow up on outstanding documents, signatures, filings and administrative requirements.

Support other administrative requirements across the company when needed.



What We Expect



Accuracy: Financial information must be checked before it is reported.

Ownership: If something does not reconcile or information is missing, investigate and follow through until it is resolved.

Timeliness: Monthly accounts and recurring finance tasks must stay current.

Early escalation: Raise discrepancies, cash-flow concerns, missing documents or compliance risks early.

Documentation: Records must be organized so another person can understand and verify the work.

Improvement: Identify recurring errors or inefficient processes and recommend practical improvements.



Qualifications & Skills



Minimum 2–3 years of bookkeeping or accounting experience.

Strong hands-on experience with Xero.

Strong understanding of bookkeeping, reconciliations and financial statements.

Excellent attention to detail and numerical accuracy.

Comfortable working with spreadsheets and financial data.

Strong organizational and follow-up skills.

Able to work independently and manage recurring deadlines.

Good written and spoken English.

Comfortable learning new systems and using AI tools for research and administrative work.

Experience with inventory-based businesses is an advantage.

Experience with Dext, Cin7 or similar systems is an advantage.

HR or administrative experience is an advantage but not required.

Accounting or Finance qualifications are preferred, but demonstrated practical bookkeeping capability and accuracy are more important.



How Success Is Measured



Success means the company accounts remain accurate, reconciled and up to date, monthly financial information can be relied upon, outstanding issues are identified early, and management does not need to repeatedly check or chase routine Finance, HR and administrative work.

This role suits someone who is comfortable taking responsibility for accuracy and wants broader exposure beyond bookkeeping within a small company.

description:
Summary

We're a high-volume land flipping business looking for a sharp Land Pricing Analyst to join our team.



You'll be analyzing and pricing vacant land properties (mostly rural/desert parcels) using comparable sales and our established criteria.



The work is process-driven and steady — ideal for someone who enjoys focused analytical work.



You don't need a real estate background — if you're analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable doing focused solo work, we'll teach you the rest.

What you'll do:



Analyze and price a high volume of vacant land properties

Select and evaluate comparable sales, adjusting for differences in size, access, utilities, terrain, and location

Cross-reference data from county records, GIS/parcel maps, and assessor sites

Follow a structured process for pricing and basic due diligence

Flag unusual or higher-risk properties for review rather than forcing a number

Keep clean, organized records of your work



Skills we're looking for:



Strong comp selection judgment — knowing which sales are truly comparable and which to discard

Sound adjustment reasoning — understanding that price per acre isn't linear and adjusting accordingly

Data fluency — fast and accurate with spreadsheets and pulling data from multiple sources

Consistency — applying the same logic the same way across high volume

Attention to detail — catching access issues, easements, flood zones, and landlocked parcels

Good judgment — knowing the limits of the analysis and when to escalate



Who you are:



Analytical and detail-oriented

Some technical or analytical background is a plus (data, finance, engineering, CS, or similar), but not required

Comfortable with focused, heads-down work for long stretches

Self-directed and reliable

Able to communicate clearly

Solid internet connection



This is high-volume work, so consistency and accuracy both matter. If you take pride in clean, careful analysis, you'll fit in well here.



Please submit a short voice sample why you would be a good fit for this job.

description:
Phone Sales VA (80% Sales, 20% Ops) | $4/hr + $5 Per Booked Call + Quota Bonus



ABOUT THE ROLE

WellKept is a premium residential cleaning company in Georgia. We need a long-term phone sales VA who is confident in their ability to book calls and wants their pay to reflect it.



This role is 80% sales and 20% operations.



Sales (80%): Pick up every call within 2 rings, qualify the customer, quote, handle objections, upsell, and book the clean. You'll live on the phone.



Ops (20%): Keep 
 and ScheduleDrop updated, follow up with leads, and make sure every booking is set up right.





PAY AND SCHEDULE

Training (Days 1-6): $3/hr

After training: $4/hr base + $5 for every booked call

Month 3 quota bonus: Starting at the beginning of month 3, book 40 calls and earn an extra $50 bonus

Your base is modest on purpose. Your earnings come from how many calls you book, and there is no cap on commission.

Paid via Wise: Day 5 EOD for training, then every Friday



THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF

You're confident you can turn inbound calls into booked cleanings

You're proactive. You don't wait to be told what to do next, you find it and do it

You want to be paid for performance, not just for showing up

You're comfortable with a $4/hr base and want the commission upside

You're coachable, reliable, and sharp on the phone



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

You want a flat hourly wage with no performance component

You're not comfortable with sales calls and handling objections

You're not proactive. If you need constant direction or tend to coast, this will not work. Seriously lazy people, please don't apply.



THE JOB → 80% sales, 20% ops

Sales (80%): Pick up every call within 2 rings, qualify the customer, quote, handle objections, upsell, and book the clean. You'll live on the phone. You'll be doing both inbound and outbound calls.

Ops (20%): Keep 
 and ScheduleDrop updated, follow up with leads, and make sure every booking is set up right. This includes some admin and operations work, and I keep an open door policy so your workload stays balanced. If it ever feels like too much, come talk to me.



Training: Mon-Fri, 9am-1pm

After training: Mon-Fri, 9am-3pm



TRAINING SCHEDULE

Day 1: Intro meeting, then self-study (Klean modules and sales videos)

Day 2: Screen-share tutorials of our tools, then a mock client on Close and ScheduleDrop

Day 3: You walk me through everything as if I'm the trainee, plus upselling and rebuttal practice and a mock call

Days 4-6: Mock calls and live incoming customers, then you present your morning routine and shift plan





TO APPLY

You'll be prioritized if you mention in your message subject and body that you've had cleaning industry experience.



1. Send me your resume.

2. In the first sentence of your message, tell me whether you have cleaning industry experience.

3. In one or two sentences, tell me why I should choose you over any other sales VA.



If you're a fit, I'll reply with a link to book a video meeting, and we'll move into onboarding right away. Applications missing any of these will not be considered.

Hours: Monday through Saturday, 9:30 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern. Full-time or part-time within those hours.

title: Lead Generation & Sales Operations VA (AI-Assisted): Full-time
description:
TOK AI Consulting · Remote, Philippines-based · Full-time (40 hrs/week) · USD $600/month base plus performance bonuses (about USD $950 a month once you hit target)



About the role

I'm hiring a Philippines-based VA to build my sales pipeline. The work covers researching the right prospects, keeping my CRM clean, preparing personalised outreach and booking discovery calls.



This is not a general admin role. It suits someone who researches accurately, keeps systems tidy, uses AI tools well, and checks AI output rather than trusting the first draft.



We start with Australia. Europe is added later, as you grow into the role.



About the business

TOK AI Consulting helps founder-led and CEO-led businesses adopt AI in practical, commercially sound ways. That includes AI strategy, AI policy, team training and implementation support. My clients are business owners and senior leaders who value evidence, clarity and doing what we say we'll do. Your work d
 which of them I get to speak with.





What you'll do

• Build and update lead lists in 
 and LinkedIn Sales Navigator from our ideal client profiles, micro-segments and current campaigns.

• Research LinkedIn profiles, company websites and public signals (hiring, funding, leadership changes, public comments on AI) to judge fit.

• Apply our lead-scoring rules and offer-matching logic to d
 who gets outreach first.

• Draft first-pass LinkedIn messages and cold
s with templates and Claude (provided by TOK).

• Personalise every message with real company, buyer and trigger-event context. No generic "I came across your profile".

• Keep HubSpot records accurate: contacts, tags, notes, deal stages and follow-up tasks.

• Manage inbox follow-ups and book discovery calls into my calendar.

• Maintain structured files for messaging, offers, objections, signals and sales materials. These are the knowledge files our AI workflows run on.

• Review AI output carefully, and improve prompts or workflows when quality drops.

• Flag patterns, objections and messaging insights that would improve the system.





Must-haves

• 3+ years of VA or sales-support work in at least two of: B2B lead generation, LinkedIn prospecting, CRM administration, outreach support, research, or executive assistance.

• Strong written English. Australian founders notice a sloppy sentence immediately.

• Hands-on use of a CRM (HubSpot preferred), Google Workspace and at least one AI assistant (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar).

• Careful research: you can tell a good-fit company from a bad one and explain why.

• High accuracy in CRM work, documentation and follow-up.

• Proof that you have taught yourself a new tool or process and used it in real work.

• A computer, a mobile phone, reliable internet, a backup power or internet plan, and a quiet place to work.

Nice-to-haves

• 
 or LinkedIn Sales Navigator experience.

• Experience supporting Australian clients or professional-services firms.

• Experience writing or refining AI prompts.





You'll fit well if you are

• Highly conscientious. You check your own work before anyone else sees it.

• Calm and sceptical. You treat AI output as a first draft, not a final answer.

• Commercially curious. You want to understand why a buyer says yes, not just follow the template.

• Coachable. You take direct feedback as information, not as a personal attack, and you improve quickly.

• Independent. You work well once priorities and standards are clear.





What success looks like in 90 days

• You reach Proficient by delivering 25 qualified leads a month for 3 months in a row.

    ◦ A qualified lead meets our scoring threshold, with the evidence logged in HubSpot.

    ◦ My weekly spot-check must find fewer than 10% errors.

    ◦ Reaching Proficient earns a USD $200 bonus.



• Your outreach drafts need only light edits before I approve them (target: [confirm: 8 in 10] approved with minor changes).

• HubSpot is current: every active lead has a stage, a next step and a follow-up date.

• Discovery calls are being booked from warm outreach.

• You have learned at least one new skill on your own (from a course, YouTube or similar) and applied it to the work.

• Our knowledge files are organised and ready for the next campaign.





Working style

• Remote and flexible. Work around family and other commitments.

• Overlap with Australian business hours is preferred, for example 2 hours a day. Perth is on Manila time. Sydney is 2 hours ahead of Manila under AEST and 3 hours ahead under AEDT (October to April).

• Time zones. I travel across APAC and Europe, so I'll sometimes message outside your hours. Reply in your next working session unless I mark the message urgent.

• Deadlines. Occasionally a client deadline needs extra hours or a weekend. It isn't often, and I'll give as much notice as I can.

• Confidentiality. Handling client and prospect data carefully is essential.





Pay and growth [$950 a month once you hit target]

• Base: USD $600/month, full-time (40 hrs/week).

• Call bonus: USD $10 for each qualified discovery call you book. A qualified call means the prospect fits our ideal client profile and attends the call. [target 25 = $250+/month]

• Proficient bonus: USD $200 the first time you deliver 25 qualified leads a month for 3 months in a row.

• Monthly target bonus: USD $100 for every month after that in which you keep hitting 25 a month and quality holds.



• Pay review: your base pay is reviewed at 6 months.



• After 6 months: USD $20/month for an internet upgrade and USD $20/month for an AI tool upgrade.

• After 12 months: a year-end bonus of one month's pay.

• After 2 years: HMO health insurance, and a cash bonus from a share of profits, paid every 6 months.

• After 3 years: HMO for dependents, and 10–15 days of paid time off. [confirm wording: see Section 6]





How fast you earn the bonuses depends on the effort you put into self learning. The fastest VA I've worked with reached full productivity in 3 months. Most take 4–5 months.



The role starts as an independent contractor engagement, paid against agreed outputs. Once the role is stable and closely managed, we may move to an employee or Employer-of-Record arrangement.





How to apply

Start your message with the subject line "Pipeline Builder: [Your Name]". Applications without it won't be read. 



Then send:

1. A short introduction in clear English, written by you (no more than 150 words).

2. A summary of your experience in lead research, CRM management or outreach support, with the tools you used.

3. A personalised LinkedIn message (no more than 80 words) to the Managing Director of an Australian professional-services firm who has started speaking publicly about AI. Name a real firm, and tell us where you found the signal.

4. Three sentences on how you use AI tools and how you check their output.



Shortlisted applicants complete a paid 2-hour trial task (USD $15) before an interview.
salary: $950 a month once you hit target

title: International Growth Marketer
description:
International Growth Marketer



CoolHed Pty Ltd

Remote – International Applicants Welcome

Full-Time | Contractor or Employee

Start: Immediate

Location: Remote, with Gold Coast hybrid welcome



About CoolHed



CoolHed is an Australian company developing reusable cooling solutions for heat stress, athletic recovery, workplace safety, and everyday thermoregulation.



We are growing across Australia and expanding into the United States, Japan, and B2B workplace markets.



We're looking for an experienced Growth Marketer who can take ownership of our online marketing and help turn traffic into measurable sales.



This is a hands-on role. We're looking for someone who enjoys running campaigns, testing ideas, improving conversions, and seeing measurable results.



The Role



As our International Growth Marketer, you'll be responsible for growing CoolHed through:



Paid advertising

Amazon

SEO

 & CRM

Website conversion

Lead generation

B2B sales support

Creative testing



You'll work directly with the Founder/CEO and have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact as we expand into international markets.



Key Responsibilities

Paid Advertising

Plan, launch, manage, and optimise Meta, Google, and TikTok campaigns.

Test different creative concepts, hooks, offers, and audiences.

Manage advertising budgets based on performance.

Identify underperforming campaigns and improve or replace them.

Develop campaigns for Australia initially, followed by the US and other markets.

Amazon

Manage and improve Amazon listings.

Work with Amazon PPC campaigns and keyword targeting.

Improve product titles, bullet points, images, A+ Content, and backend keywords.

Monitor advertising performance, rankings, reviews, and inventory.

Help expand CoolHed across Amazon Australia, the US, and eventually Japan.

SEO & Content

Identify valuable commercial search opportunities.

Improve website pages, product pages, titles, internal linking, and SEO structure.

Create or coordinate useful content that can generate traffic and sales.

Use Google Search Console and other tools to monitor performance.

 & CRM

Manage email marketing and customer flows.

Build and improve welcome, abandoned-cart, post-purchase, win-back, and other automated campaigns.

Segment customers and leads.

Monitor email performance and revenue.

Maintain good email deliverability and list hygiene.

Sales & Business Development

Support B2B lead generation and outreach.

Help create sales materials, email sequences, and LinkedIn outreach campaigns.

Support follow-up with workplace, safety, mining, construction, healthcare, and other potential business customers.

Assist with affiliate and ambassador opportunities.

Help develop campaigns around seasonal opportunities and key markets.

Website & Conversion

Identify ways to improve the customer journey and checkout experience.

Develop landing pages for advertising campaigns.

Improve product pages, bundles, FAQs, offers, and trust elements.

Test different approaches to increase conversion rates.

What We're Looking For



We're looking for a hands-on marketer, not someone who simply manages an agency or delegates everything.



You should have experience with several of the following:



Meta Ads Manager

Google Ads

TikTok Ads

Amazon Seller Central

Amazon PPC

Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar

Klaviyo or another email marketing platform

Google Analytics 4

Google Search Console

Shopify

Canva / CapCut

CRM and marketing automation tools



Experience marketing physical products, e-commerce, Amazon, wellness, sports, outdoor products, workplace safety, or similar products is highly valued.



Qualifications & Skills

3+ years of hands-on digital marketing experience is preferred.

Experience managing paid advertising for a physical product or e-commerce brand.

Strong understanding of performance marketing and conversion.

Experience with Amazon Seller Central and PPC is highly preferred.

Good understanding of email marketing and CRM.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent written English.

Able to work independently and take ownership of projects.

Comfortable testing, learning, and making decisions based on data.

Strong commercial mindset — you care about sales and profitable growth, not just likes and impressions.

Comfortable working remotely and providing regular updates.



You don't need to be an expert in every area. However, we are looking for someone who is capable of getting hands-on and making things happen.



What Success Looks Like



Your goal is simple: help CoolHed generate more profitable sales.



Over your first 90 days, you'll be expected to:



Audit our existing website, advertising, Amazon, email, and tracking.

Develop a clear growth plan.

Launch and optimise paid campaigns.

Improve our Amazon listings and PPC.

Establish effective email flows.

Build reliable reporting and tracking.

Identify what is working and scale it.

Create repeatable marketing processes that the company can continue to use as we grow.

Compensation



Base: AUD $1,600 per month



Performance Bonus: 8% of Net Attributable Profit generated through the channels you manage.



The bonus is designed to reward profitable growth and is not capped during the first six months.



CoolHed also covers approved marketing software and tools required for the role.



First 60 days: Base compensation applies, with an additional one-off $400 kick-start bonus when the required Week-2 audit and Week-4 campaign setup are completed on time.



Working Arrangement

Remote / international applicants welcome.

Minimum 3 hours of overlap with Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST) on campaign days.

Full-time commitment.

Contractor or employee arrangement depending on location and circumstances.

Immediate start available.

How to Apply



Please don't send a generic marketing CV alone.



We'd like to see evidence of what you've actually achieved.



Please provide:



Your CV.

A short case study showing a product or e-commerce brand you helped grow.

The channels you managed and the results you achieved.

Your experience with Amazon, paid advertising, and email marketing.

A short audit of CoolHed's website or Amazon listing with 5 improvements you would make.

Examples of campaigns, listings, or marketing work you've personally worked on where possible.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a paid 4-hour practical task ($150 AUD) involving a CoolHed channel audit and a 14-day growth plan.



Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is hungry, practical, commercially minded, and willing to take ownership.



If you enjoy looking at numbers, testing new ideas, improving campaigns, and turning marketing into actual sales, we'd love to hear from you.



Join CoolHed and help us build an international brand from Australia.

title: Direct Mail Handwriting Assistant – U.S. Plumbing Company
description:
Direct Mail Handwriting Assistant – U.S. Plumbing Company



We are a growing plumbing company in North Carolina, USA, looking for a reliable person in the Philippines to help us with an ongoing direct-mail marketing campaign.



This is a long-term position for the right person.



What You’ll Be Doing



Your primary responsibility will be handwriting letters and envelopes that will be mailed to prospective customers in the United States.



We will provide:



* The letter/message to copy

* Names and mailing addresses

* Instructions and examples

* Letter and envelope specifications



You will:



* Handwrite letters neatly and naturally

* Hand-address envelopes

* Follow our formatting instructions carefully

* Maintain accurate records of completed letters

* Double-check names and addresses for accuracy

* Prepare completed batches for shipment to our company in North Carolina



What We’re Looking For



We are NOT looking for perfect calligraphy.



We want handwriting that is:



* Easy to read

* Friendly

* Natural-looking

* Consistent

* Personal rather than machine-generated



Accuracy is extremely important. Names and addresses must be copied correctly.



You should also be dependable, communicate well, meet deadlines, and be comfortable completing repetitive work without sacrificing quality.



Initial Paid Test



Before hiring, we will ask qualified applicants to complete a small paid sample project.



We will provide several sample names, addresses, and a short letter. You will handwrite them and send us clear photographs of the completed samples.



If your work is a good fit, we would like to establish an ongoing working relationship.



Potential Workload



We expect to send direct-mail campaigns regularly, so there is potential for consistent ongoing work.



The number of letters may increase substantially if our campaigns perform well.



Compensation



Please include your requested:



1. Hourly rate



AND



2. Price per completed handwritten letter + addressed envelope



We are particularly interested in eventually using a per-piece payment structure once we establish expected quality and production speed.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your name and location in the Philippines.

2. Your requested hourly rate.

3. Your requested price per handwritten letter and addressed envelope.

4. Approximately how many letters you believe you can complete per hour.

5. A photo showing a sample of your normal handwriting.

6. Any previous experience with handwritten letters, postcards, direct mail, or similar work.

7. The word PLUMBER at the beginning of your application so we know you read the entire job description.



We value reliability, accuracy and quality more than simply finding the lowest price.



We are looking for someone we can work with for a long time as our company and direct-mail campaigns grow.

title: Short-Form Video Editor & Content Creator
description:
Summary:

We're looking for a creative and dependable Short-Form Video Editor & Content Creator to help grow a personal brand focused on business, entrepreneurship, training, and education.

This isn't a traditional hourly position.

We pay for results, not hours.

There is no time tracking or requirement to sit at your computer for a certain number of hours. If you can create a great piece of content efficiently, that's a good thing. We care about quality, consistency, meeting deadlines, and creating content people actually want to watch.

We're looking for someone who can eventually do more than simply follow editing instructions. We want someone who can understand the content, recognize engaging moments, and help turn raw ideas and footage into great social media content.





Job Description



Key Responsibilities

Your primary responsibility will be turning raw footage and existing content into engaging short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other platforms.

This includes editing raw talking-head footage; creating strong pacing and clean cuts; adding engaging captions, graphics, B-roll, music, sound effects, zooms, and transitions when appropriate; and maintaining consistent branding and quality.

You'll also help repurpose long-form content. You may receive a training, webinar, interview, podcast, or longer video and be expected to identify the strongest moments that could become individual short-form videos.



Some assignments may be simpler than others. More advanced projects that fall substantially outside the scope of a standard short-form edit may be priced separately before work begins.



B-Roll & Visual Storytelling

We're specifically looking for someone who understands good B-roll, not someone who just adds random stock footage.

You should understand how to use visuals to reinforce what's being said, maintain attention, illustrate an idea, create emotion, and make videos more visually interesting without over-editing it.



Content Development

Depending on your skills, you may also help with:

 • Creating graphics/carousels 

 • Brainstorming hooks and content ideas 

 • Repurposing one piece of content into multiple posts 

 • Researching trends within our niche 

 • Identifying successful editing styles and formats 

 • Creating thumbnails/covers 

 • Helping organize and maintain a content library/calendar 

 • Scheduling/publishing content 



Qualifications

You should have demonstrated experience editing engaging short-form content and a strong understanding of Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

We're looking for someone with:

 • Strong short-form editing skills 

 • Good judgment about pacing and viewer retention 

 • An eye for engaging B-roll 

 • Strong attention to detail 

 • Creativity without unnecessary over-editing 

 • Ability to follow a brand/style guide 

 • Ability to accept feedback and improve quickly 

 • Ability to work independently 

 • Reliable communication 

 • Consistent ability to meet deadlines 

 • Understanding of current short-form trends, hooks, and editing styles 

Experience with CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or comparable professional editing software is welcome. We're more interested in the quality of your finished work than which software you use.



Equipment Requirements

You must have:

 • A reliable computer capable of handling video editing 

 • Reliable internet 

 • Enough storage and performance to download, edit, and upload video files consistently 

 • Your own editing software/tools 



What We Offer

 • Complete work independence, no time tracking 

 • Work from anywhere 

 • Flexible schedule as long as deadlines are met 

 • Consistent ongoing work for the right person 

 • Clear expectations and feedback 

 • Opportunity for increased volume and responsibilities 

 • Opportunity for higher-paying/advanced projects as skills and responsibilities grow 

We want this to become a long-term working relationship with someone who learns our brand and becomes increasingly capable of turning raw content into finished posts independently.



How to Apply

Please submit:

 1. Your resume

 2. Your portfolio that includes 3–5 examples of short-form videos you've personally edited. 

 3. A brief explanation of what you believe makes a short-form video engaging.

title: Wholesale real estate
description:
Summary

Virtual Assistant Role

Role: Inbound SMS Lead Screener

Primary Objective

Your only responsibility is to qualify fresh inbound SMS leads generated through our marketing campaigns.

You are not responsible for negotiating or closing deals. Your job is simply to identify motivated sellers and gather basic information before handing the lead off.

Daily Responsibilities

Monitor GoHighLevel

Stay logged into GoHighLevel during your scheduled shift.

Watch for all new inbound SMS responses.

Response Time (Most Important KPI)

Every positive response must receive a phone call within 5-15 minutes.

If you cannot reach the seller:

Call 3x

Leave a voi
 (when appropriate)

Send a follow-up text

Place In Redial (redial x2 if on the second batch)

Filter Leads

No Motivation

Examples:

Not interested

Wrong number

Already sold

Just asking random question

No interest in selling

Action:

Mark conversation as Read

No further action needed

Positive Responses

Examples:

"Yes"

"Maybe"

"Thinking about selling"

"What's your offer?"

"Call me"

"I'm interested"

A number below or near market value

Action:

Call immediately (within 5 minutes)

Gather surface-level information (price, condition, motivation, timeline)

Mark the lead appropriately

Notify acquisitions if qualified

Information to Gather

Do not overcomplicate the call.

Simply collect:

Seller Name

Property Address

Is this the property they're selling?

Asking Price (if any)

Condition of the property

Confirm Bed/Bath/Sqft

Reason for selling

Timeline to sell

Best callback number

Best time to reach them for an offer call.

Keep the conversation natural.

Qualified Lead

A lead is considered Qualified if:

✅ They own (or control) the property

✅ They are willing to sell

✅ They show some level of motivation

If they meet those three criteria, they should be passed to acquisitions.

End of Shift Requirements

Metrics to track:

Hours Worked

Positive Responses

Qualified Leads

Goal: Turn every interested SMS response into a qualified lead for the acquisitions team.

description:
About Us

Sola Kids Dental & Orthodontics is a growing pediatric dental group with four offices in Los Angeles, California. We provide elevated dental and orthodontic care to kids and young adults, mostly from Spanish-speaking families. Our call center schedules appointments and answers patient questions in English and Spanish. We are looking for a sharp, detail-oriented Quality Control Specialist to help our call center team deliver a great experience on every call.



Schedule



20 hours per week: Monday to Friday, 4 hours per day

title: SEO Coordinator / Specialist
description:
About us

Midstream Digital Marketing gets financial advisory firms to the top of local search and keeps them there. One of our clients has held the #1 Google map pack position in Houston — one of the most competitive advisor markets in the US — since 2015.

We already have a full team of SEO specialists, writers, and web people doing the work. What we don't have is one person whose entire job is making sure all of it is actually happening, and actually working.

This is not a task-execution role. You won't be writing the content or building the citations. You'll be the person who catches it when a ranking slips, when a Google Business Profile post didn't go out, when a page got published with broken schema, or when a client account has quietly gone three weeks without anything shipping.





What you'll own

• Monitor rankings, traffic, and Search Console across all client accounts — daily on key terms, weekly on the full set

• Spot and escalate problems early: ranking drops, traffic declines, indexing issues, crawl errors, site outages, review-rating dips

• Audit the team's completed work against our standards before it reaches the client — titles, metas, schema, internal links, citation accuracy, GBP posts

• Track that every recurring deliverable actually shipped, on every account, every month

• Keep ClickUp honest: flag tasks that are stalled, overdue, or marked complete without the work being done

• Run competitor monitoring — know when someone is moving on our clients' positions before our clients do

• Build the monthly performance report for each account: what moved, what didn't, what's at risk

• Give the team specific, documented feedback on what needs rework and why





What we need from you

• 5+ years of hands-on SEO, with significant local SEO and Google Business Profile experience. You must have done this work yourself to be able to judge it

• You've been through multiple Google algorithm updates and know the difference between a real ranking problem and normal volatility

• The ability to look at someone else's finished page and tell whether it was done properly

• Fluent in Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and a rank tracker (Ahrefs, SEMrush, or similar)

• Comfortable in WordPress — you'll be inspecting live client sites, not just dashboards

• Strong written English. Your reports and your feedback both need to be clear and professional

• Genuinely detail-oriented. This role is 80% noticing things

• Willing to raise problems directly, including when the answer is "this was done wrong, it needs redoing." If you avoid difficult conversations, this isn't your role

• Reliable internet with a backup connection





Nice to have

• Experience overseeing or QA-ing other SEO people's work

• Financial services, wealth management, or other regulated/YMYL experience

• Looker Studio or automated reporting

• Schema markup you can read and write by hand

• Elementor





Why this role is worth your time

• Long-term, stable position. Our people stay for years, not months

• Paid on time, every time, no exceptions

• 13th month pay

• Real authority — your findings drive what the team works on

• You work directly with the owner, not through layers of account managers

• You'll see your work hold rankings for firms managing hundreds of millions in assets



How to apply

Apply through this job posting. If you have trouble applying here,
 your application to 
 instead.

title: Sales Operations Coordinator
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY



Our client is a premium TikTok Shop and social commerce growth agency working with DTC and e-commerce brands doing $5M to $100M+ in revenue.



THE ROLE



Reports to: Revenue Director (direct)

Schedule: Remote, EST hours, non-client-facing



You are the Revenue Director's right hand on the backend of the sales team. You handle data collection, make sure closers and setters complete their end-of-day (EOD) reporting, validate data accuracy across the dashboards, and manage the spreadsheets that run the sales function.



You do not manage or discipline reps. You collect, verify, and report. If something is late, missing, or does not add up, it goes straight to the Revenue Director, and he handles it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



1. Data collection and EOD accountability



- Confirm every closer and setter has submitted their EOD by the deadline

- Log EOD numbers into the manual tracking sheets, accurately and the same day

- Report misses and late submissions to the Revenue Director each day



2. Data validation (HubSpot and dashboards)



- Cross-check reported EOD numbers against HubSpot activity, call logs, recordings, and reporting dashboards

- Confirm deals, stages, notes, and next steps are logged correctly

- Log every discrepancy (reported vs. actual) and send a short daily summary to the Revenue Director

- Do not confront reps. Document and escalate



3. Spreadsheet management



- Build and maintain trackers, spreadsheets, dashboards, and reporting templates

- Keep sheets clean, organized, and consistent so anyone on the team can find what they need

- Update weekly and monthly performance reports for the Revenue Director

- Spot recurring issues in the data and suggest better ways to track them



4. Backend support



- Handle ad hoc operational tasks from the Revenue Director

- Light Zapier and integration work to remove repetitive admin where it is safe to do so

- Document processes so they can be handed off



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- 2+ years in sales ops, admin, or a support role for a sales team

- Strong Google Sheets and Google Workspace skills

- Working knowledge of HubSpot (views, properties, reports)

- Comfortable with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) and basic Zapier

- Detail-obsessed: you notice when numbers do not add up

- Strong written English and complete discretion (you will see sensitive performance and revenue data)

- Must work Eastern Standard Time (EST) hours. Core shift: 9am to 4pm EST. Please confirm you can commit to this before applying



NICE TO HAVE



- Agency, e-commerce, or social commerce background

- Canva or Google Slides design sense

- Familiarity with Slack, Fathom, or Loom



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



First 30 days: 100% of closer and setter EODs collected and logged daily, validation routine running, and daily summary delivered on time.



First 60 days: Discrepancy log producing clear patterns by rep, and core trackers and dashboards shipped.



First 90 days: You run the data and accountability function with minimal direction and proactively flag issues to the Revenue Director.



To apply:

Submit a 1-2 minute video describing why you'd be a good fit for this role.

title: CRM Manager (Hubspot)
description:

This isn't a data entry role. You d
 how the system should work and you build it.

We’re looking for a **talented designer first and foremost** — someone with a strong eye for premium visuals, branding, and ad creative.

- A strong portfolio

title: Operations and Sales Director
description:
Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time



About the Role



We are looking for a highly motivated, organized, and experienced Director of Sales & Operations to join our team.



This is a hands-on, high-accountability position responsible for managing our seller and buyer leads from initial contact through the preparation of businesses for sale.



You will personally contact leads, book and conduct discovery calls, gather financial and business information, manage follow-up, coordinate documentation, and use our AI-powered systems to help prepare business valuations and Confidential Information Memorandums (CIMs).



This is NOT an entry-level position.



We are looking for someone who is confident speaking with business owners, understands sales, is relentless about follow-up, stays extremely organized, and can leverage technology and AI to move quickly and efficiently.



Schedule

Full-time

Monday–Friday

8:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time

Must be available and responsive during these hours

Core Responsibilities

Seller Lead Management



You will manage seller leads from their first inquiry through the initial stages of preparing their business for sale.



Responsibilities include:



Contact every new seller lead promptly.

Call, text, and follow up consistently until contact is made.

Schedule seller appointments.

Conduct initial discovery and qualification calls.

Ask detailed questions about the seller and their business.

Gather information regarding revenue, profit, expenses, employees, owner involvement, assets, leases, customers, growth opportunities, reason for selling, timeline, and other relevant information.

Request and collect financial statements and required documentation.

Keep sellers moving through the process.

Identify missing information and follow up until it is received.

Make sure no seller lead falls through the cracks.

Buyer Lead Management



You will also manage and qualify prospective buyers.



Responsibilities include:



Contact every buyer lead.

Schedule buyer appointments.

Conduct buyer qualification calls.

Evaluate buyer experience, financial ability, available cash, financing options, industry preferences, location preferences, acquisition criteria, and timeline.

Determine what type of business the buyer is looking to acquire.

Ensure NDAs and required documentation are completed before confidential information is released.

Match qualified buyers with appropriate listings.

Maintain consistent follow-up with active buyers.

Track buyers who may be a fit for future listings.

Maintain an organized database of qualified buyers and acquisition criteria.

Business Valuations



You will use our established systems and AI tools to assist in preparing business valuations.



Responsibilities include:



Review seller financial information.

Identify potential add-backs.

Calculate and review SDE and EBITDA when appropriate.

Research applicable industry multiples.

Use our AI systems to assist with valuation analysis.

Identify missing, inconsistent, or questionable financial information.

Prepare valuations for internal review.

Make sure the final valuation is logical, complete, accurate, and professional.



AI will do much of the heavy lifting, but you are responsible for the quality, accuracy, and completeness of the information being entered and reviewed.



CIM Preparation



You will use our AI systems to prepare Confidential Information Memorandums (CIMs) for businesses being marketed for sale.



This includes:



Gathering information from sellers.

Reviewing financial information.

Preparing company overviews.

Documenting products and services.

Identifying competitive advantages.

Outlining staffing and owner responsibilities.

Identifying growth opportunities.

Organizing financial information.

Reviewing AI-generated CIMs.

Correcting errors and missing information.

Improving the final document.

Following up with sellers when information is missing.



You are responsible for making sure every CIM is accurate, professional, complete, and ready to be presented to qualified buyers.



Sales & Operations



This position plays a critical role in managing the day-to-day operations surrounding our sales pipeline.



You will:



Maintain and update the CRM daily.

Track every buyer and seller lead.

Make sure every lead has a clear status and next action.

Track appointments and follow-ups.

Make sure required documents are collected.

Keep files and deal information organized.

Identify stalled leads and deals.

Coordinate with brokers, administrative staff, and management.

Make sure deadlines and next steps are completed.

Help improve systems, processes, and AI workflows.

Identify problems before they become bigger problems.

Keep management informed about pipeline activity and operational issues.

Take ownership of getting tasks completed without constant supervision.

Required Experience

This is NOT an entry-level position.



Applicants MUST have previous sales experience.



You should have experience with:



Calling and communicating with leads.

Qualifying prospects.

Booking appointments.

Conducting sales or discovery calls.

Following up with prospects.

Managing a sales pipeline.

Working inside a CRM or similar system.

Managing multiple prospects at different stages of a sales process.

Working toward measurable sales goals.



Experience in any of the following is a major plus:



Business brokerage

Real estate

B2B sales

Financial services

M&A

Business acquisitions

High-ticket sales

Consulting

Entrepreneurship



If you do not have previous sales experience, please do not apply.



Technology Requirements



You must be comfortable working in a technology-driven environment.



Required:



Must have an iPhone.

Must be comfortable calling and texting leads from an iPhone.

Must be comfortable using AI tools.

Must be comfortable working inside a CRM.

Must be able to learn new software and technology quickly.

Must be comfortable using multiple systems simultaneously.

Must be able to use technology to increase productivity and speed.

Who We're Looking For



The right person is:



Extremely organized

Confident and professional on the phone

Comfortable speaking with business owners

Persistent and consistent with follow-up

Motivated by results

Comfortable with sales

Detail-oriented

Comfortable working with numbers and financial information

Quick to learn new technology

Comfortable using AI

Able to manage multiple priorities

Independent and self-motivated

Solution-oriented

Accountable for results

Someone who takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do



You should be the type of person who sees a problem and thinks:



"How do I fix this?"



—not—



"Someone should tell me what to do."



How Success Will Be Measured



Your performance will be measured using clear activity and performance metrics, including:



Speed to lead

Percentage of leads contacted

Seller appointments booked

Buyer appointments booked

Appointment show rate

Seller conversion rate

Buyer qualification rate

Follow-up completion

Valuations completed

CIMs completed

Turnaround time

CRM accuracy

Qualified opportunities moved forward

Overall organization of the buyer and seller pipeline

The Bottom Line



Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Every seller lead gets contacted.



Every buyer lead gets contacted.



Every qualified prospect gets an appointment.



Every appointment gets followed up with.



Every qualified seller gets moved toward a valuation and CIM.



Every qualified buyer gets matched with the right opportunities.



You will use AI, automation, and technology to work faster, but you are ultimately responsible for making sure the work gets done correctly, completely, and on time.



If you are a strong salesperson who is highly organized, loves follow-up, is comfortable with technology and AI, and knows how to take ownership of a sales and operations pipeline, we want to hear from you.



To Apply



Please submit your resume and include a brief explanation of:



Your previous sales experience

Why you believe you are qualified for this position

Your experience using CRMs and technology

Your experience using AI tools

Your availability to work Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time

title: Video Creator + Editor (AI UGC, Editing, Scripting)
description:
We're spending $100k+ a month on Meta and need more winning creative than we can make in-house. We're looking for a weapon: someone who writes, edits, and ships ads that convert, at volume, without needing to be babysat.



What you'll do



Write scripts and hooks for direct response video (15 to 45 seconds)

Edit real footage: crew B-roll, customer-shot UGC, and talking head content

Produce AI UGC with tools like Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, Kling, and Seedance (we already have accounts and a trained avatar ready to go)

Design static ads and carousels

Turn one winning concept into 10+ variations: new hooks, new first 3 seconds, new CTAs, new formats

Review the numbers with us (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, cost per lead, cost per booked job) and iterate on what's working



How to Apply: Sample Ad Required



This is a serious opportunity. We're spending six figures a month on Meta and we need a weapon, so every applicant has to show us what they can do before we talk.



The brief: our client is one of the biggest moving companies in the US, and they only do long distance, out of state moves. Research the market, write the script, and produce a finished AI UGC ad for them. Here's an example of the style we're working with: 
 



CTA = Click the button to get a free quote / moving cost calculator 



Who you're talking to: middle-aged homeowners (think 35 to 55) with a 2+ bedroom house who are moving their whole household to another state. Most of the people seeing these ads will be women, so write to her, and the person on screen should look like the audience. This is NOT a young person moving apartments or anyone moving across town. If your ad could work for a local or apartment move, it misses the brief.



Requirements:



Format: 15 to 30 seconds, vertical (9:16), fully edited and ready to run, with captions, pacing, and an end card. Not a raw generation.



Brand: use a placeholder brand name "National Pro Moving"



Compliance: the ad must follow Meta ad policy and FTC rules. That means no fake testimonials, no AI person claiming to be a customer or describing a move they never made, and no made-up claims, stats, prices, or reviews. If you're not sure a claim is allowed, leave it out.



Tools: use whatever you want.



Send us:



Your edited final sample

A few lines on who the ad targets, why you chose that hook, and what tools you used

Your portfolio, with spend and results on past ads wherever you can share them

Your availability: hours per week, time zone, and when you can start

Why we should hire you 



Start your proposal with the word "POTATO" so we know you actually read this.



Generic proposals get skipped.

title: Social Media, Local Marketing & Sales Specialist – Restaurant Brands
description:
Social Media, Local Marketing & Sales Specialist – Restaurant Brands



We are looking for an experienced Social Media, Local Marketing & Sales Specialist to create content, build local awareness, generate leads, and convert social media engagement into measurable customers and sales for our restaurant and food brands.



This is not just a video-editing or social media posting position. We are specifically looking for someone who has done this successfully before and can demonstrate previous results.



Project Scope



- Edit approximately 30 videos from raw footage we provide

- Finished videos will generally be around 2–3 minutes

- Create shorter versions when appropriate for Instagram,
, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

- Review raw footage and select the strongest clips

- Create attention-grabbing hooks and clear calls to action

- Add captions, music, transitions, graphics, and basic color correction

- Repurpose content appropriately for different platforms

- Develop a social media content plan and posting calendar

- Set up and manage social media scheduling/auto-posting tools



Local Customer Targeting



Our goal is not simply to generate views, likes, or followers.



The content and marketing should primarily reach people who live, work, study, shop, or spend time near our restaurant locations.



Create, run, monitor, and continuously optimize paid social media advertising campaigns, fine-tuning audience targeting, creative, offers, and budget based on each location’s local 1–5 mile market to improve customer acquisition and sales.



Our highest priority is customers within approximately a 1-mile radius, expanding up to approximately 5 miles around each location.



We want social media activity that results in people actually:



- Visiting our locations

- Ordering food online

- Purchasing gift cards

- Purchasing memberships or offers

- Placing group or catering orders

- Becoming repeat customers



## Local Community Marketing



The successful candidate should know how to actively build awareness within the surrounding community, including:



- Finding and engaging with local social media accounts

- Identifying nearby schools, businesses, offices, sports teams, organizations, and community groups

- Finding relevant local events and community gatherings

- Participating appropriately in local social media conversations

- Tagging and interacting with relevant local organizations and accounts

- Building relationships with potential local partners

- Identifying opportunities for promotions, collaborations, sponsorships, group orders, catering, or events

- Following up with potential customers and organizations



Sales & Customer Conversion

, and phone

Previous hands-on experience doing this type of work is required.

Experience with restaurants, food businesses, retail, hospitality, fitness, entertainment, beauty, or other location-based consumer businesses is strongly preferred.

- Proven customer acquisition or sales experience

- Strong social media video editing skills

- Understanding of current short-form content styles and trends

- Strong hooks, storytelling, and calls to action

- Experience converting social engagement into leads/customers

- CRM and lead follow-up experience

- Campaign tracking and attribution experience

- Social media scheduling/automation experience

- Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines



How to Apply

Please do not apply if your experience is limited to video editing, posting content, or generating views and followers. We are specifically looking for someone with previous experience generating measurable local customers and sales.

title: Shop Operations & Onboarding Specialist, TikTok Shop
description:
ABOUT THE JOB



Our client is a dual-badged official TikTok agency. They're a technology-driven social commerce partner for growth-minded consumer brands, combining senior human expertise with an agentic commerce stack that connects creators, brands, and platforms in one unified layer.



Their team has generated $80 Million in GMV through creator partnerships, helping 8-10 figure e-commerce brands scale through social commerce strategies. They orchestrate the full journey from discovery to checkout, transforming social from a brand channel into a primary revenue storefront.



THE ROLE



Every brand's TikTok Shop runs on work nobody sees until it breaks. You make sure it doesn't. You'll take new enterprise brands from signed contract to a live, healthy shop, then keep every shop in your pod running clean so creators and paid media can scale on top of it.



This isn't a checklist role. Shop setup is tedious and full of approvals, integrations, and policy traps. You own getting it done right and fast, without hand-holding.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Launch new shops: Run the setup from application to go
 business and brand verification, category approvals, warehouse and return addresses, and shipping templates.



- Build the catalog: Upload and optimize product listings, variants, pricing, and images. Keep SKUs accurate as brands add products and run promotions.



- Connect the systems: Set up and maintain Shopify and other e-commerce integrations, inventory sync, and 3PL or fulfillment linking so orders flow without manual fixes.



- Protect shop health: Monitor SPS, fulfillment metrics, and policy compliance. Catch violations, handle appeals, and fix issues before they hit campaign performance.



- Troubleshoot anything: Sync errors, rejected listings, stuck orders, account holds. You find the cause, fix it or escalate it to the right person, and close the loop.



- Keep onboarding on schedule: Work with the Account Manager and CSM on launch timelines, flag blockers early, and document each setup so the next launch goes faster.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- 1+ years in e-commerce operations, marketplace management, or shop setup (TikTok Shop, Amazon Seller Central, Shopify, Walmart, or similar), agency or brand side

- Detail-obsessed: you catch the wrong SKU, the missing tax setting, and the listing that will get flagged

- A problem-solver who digs in when something breaks instead of waiting for instructions

- Organized across multiple shop launches and live accounts at once

- Clear, direct writing, since most of this job happens in Slack



NICE TO HAVE



- Hands-on TikTok Seller Center experience (training is provided)

- Shopify app or integration experience

- 3PL and fulfillment workflows

- US marketplace compliance

- Comfort using AI tools to move faster



HOW WE KNOW YOU'LL BE GOOD AT THIS



- You fix a broken sync before anyone notices it was broken

- You tell your AM a launch date is at risk the day you see it, not the day it slips

- You ask one sharp question instead of guessing on a setup detail

- You'd rather document a fix once than solve the same problem five times



WHY THIS ROLE



- Above-market base pay, plus commission tied to how your pod's accounts perform

- Work with brands like Stanley 1913, Hyland's, 
, and Vegamour

- Hypergrowth: new enterprise clients are onboarded every week

- A flat structure with minimal red tape and real room to grow as the company scales



PROCESS



Submit a 1-2 minute introduction video about why you'd be a good fit for this role. 



Intro call > Skills screen > Final call with leadership
