title: Creative Brand & Social Media Assistant
description:
Pay: $2.50 USD/hour

Hours: 30 hours per week

Schedule: Remote and flexible, but Pacific Time availability is required

Communication: WhatsApp

Position: Long-term



About the Position



I am looking for a creative, reliable, and independent Brand & Social Media Assistant to join my small ecommerce business long term.



This role combines graphic design, social media content creation, and brand development. I already have an established brand identity, professional brand guidelines, logos, colors, fonts, and visual direction in place.



I am not looking for someone to completely rebrand the business. Instead, I need someone who can understand the existing brand and help expand it into a stronger, more polished, and recognizable identity across social media, packaging, marketing materials, events, and other customer touchpoints.



I am especially interested in someone who can bring fresh ideas and creative suggestions rather than simply waiting for detailed instructions for every project.



Pay & Schedule



The position pays $2.50 USD per hour for approximately 30 hours per week.



The schedule can be somewhat flexible, but you must have consistent availability during Pacific Time (PST/PDT).



You do not necessarily need to work all of your hours in one continuous block. However, your schedule should overlap enough with Pacific Time that we can communicate efficiently, review work, make revisions, and handle time sensitive requests when needed.



There may occasionally be product launches, announcements, events, or other projects that require quicker communication and turnaround.



Communication



WhatsApp is required for this position.



WhatsApp will be used for daily communication, assignments, feedback, questions, revisions, and updates.



I am looking for someone who:



• Checks messages regularly during working hours

• Responds within a reasonable amount of time

• Communicates clearly when something is unclear

• Lets me know if there will be a delay

• Provides progress updates without requiring constant follow up

• Is reliable and easy to communicate with



Strong communication is extremely important for this role.



Required Design Skills



Canva



Strong Canva experience is required.



Canva is a major part of my workflow because many recurring designs need to remain editable by myself and other members of the team.



You should be comfortable:



• Designing professionally from scratch in Canva

• Editing existing Canva files

• Creating reusable templates

• Following an established brand guide

• Organizing Canva projects and files

• Working with product photography

• Creating social media layouts

• Resizing and adapting designs

• Creating designs that can easily be updated later



I am specifically looking for someone who genuinely knows how to design within Canva rather than someone who only uses it occasionally.



Adobe Illustrator



Experience with Adobe Illustrator is also important.



You should be comfortable using Illustrator for:



• Vector artwork

• Packaging layouts

• Print materials

• Brand assets

• Product collateral

• Professional print files

• Editing and preparing existing design assets



Adobe Express



Experience with Adobe Express is also preferred for social media content, quick edits, resizing, and digital marketing materials.



Social Media Responsibilities



A major part of this position will involve helping improve and maintain the business's social media presence.



You may be responsible for creating:



• Instagram feed posts

• Instagram Stories

• Reel covers

• Product launch graphics

• New release announcements

• Presale posts

• Restock announcements

• Coming soon posts

• Giveaway graphics

• Event announcements

• Informational graphics

• Product spotlights

• Collection features

• Promotional content



I am looking for someone who understands how individual posts contribute to an overall feed.



The goal is to create social media that feels consistent and recognizable without making every post look identical.



You should also be comfortable suggesting:



• New content ideas

• Recurring content series

• Ways to improve engagement

• Creative launch concepts

• Different post formats

• Ways to strengthen brand recognition



Brand Development



I want someone who can help continue expanding an already established brand.



This may include creating or improving:



• Social media templates

• Packaging

• Business cards

• Thank you cards

• Product backing cards

• Order inserts

• Website graphics

•
 graphics

• Event signage

• Vendor materials

• Promotional cards

• Customer experience materials

• Marketing campaigns

• Other branded materials



You should understand how to take an existing brand guide and creatively apply it to new situations.



The goal is for everything a customer sees to feel connected to the same business.



Creative Independence



I am looking for someone who can work independently and does not require constant micromanagement.



I will provide direction, product information, brand guidelines, examples, and feedback.



However, I do not want to have to explain every small design decision.



If I provide a product image and tell you that I need a launch graphic, I want you to be able to review the branding, understand the information that needs to be communicated, and create a strong concept.



As you work with me longer, I expect you to learn:



• The types of designs I prefer

• What I like and dislike visually

• How I prefer information presented

• What fits the brand

• What does not fit the brand

• How different types of launches are normally handled



I want someone who becomes easier to work with over time because they understand the brand and remember previous feedback.



AI Usage



I am not looking for someone who relies heavily on AI to complete their creative work.



AI may be used occasionally as a supporting tool when appropriate, but it should not replace your own design ability, creativity, judgment, or original thinking.



I want to see your actual design skills.



The majority of your layouts, concepts, branding decisions, and creative direction should come from you.



If your normal workflow depends heavily on AI generated designs or content, this position will likely not be the right fit.



Ideal Candidate



You may be a great fit if you are:



• Experienced with Canva

• Experienced with Adobe Illustrator

• Familiar with Adobe Express

• Strong in graphic design

• Comfortable with Instagram and social media

• Familiar with branding and visual identity

• Creative and able to generate your own ideas

• Detail oriented

• Organized

• Responsive

• Reliable

• Able to manage multiple assignments

• Comfortable receiving feedback

• Able to work without constant supervision

• Available during Pacific Time

• Interested in a long term role



Experience working with ecommerce brands, collectibles, product based businesses, packaging, stationery, fandom products, or boutique brands is a plus.



What I Will Provide



You will receive access to existing materials such as:



• Brand guidelines

• Logos

• Brand colors

• Brand fonts

• Graphic elements and patterns

• Existing Canva files

• Previous social media posts

• Product photography

• Packaging examples

• Marketing materials

• Examples of designs I like and dislike



You will have an established creative foundation to work from.



How to Apply



You must submit a portfolio to be considered.



Please include:



• A link to your design portfolio

• Examples of social media graphics

• Canva work, if available

• Branding or brand development examples

• Your experience with Adobe Illustrator

• Your experience with Adobe Express

• Your availability during Pacific Time



Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.



Please submit work that represents your actual design ability and creative style.



I am looking for someone who wants to become a reliable creative part of the business, learn the brand over time, contribute ideas, and help take the overall branding and social media presence to the next level.

title: Appointment Setter / Cold Caller
description:
Cold Caller / Outbound Appointment Setter



Location: Fully Remote (Ph) Schedule: Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM–6:00 PM EST (approximately 11:00 PM–7:00 AM Manila time — this is a night shift) Compensation: $850 USD per month base + $25 USD per qualified appointment that shows + $100 USD per client that signs



About T3 Tech Partners



T3 Tech Partners is the team MSPs rely on when challenges exceed Tier 2 or internal expertise. We operate as a Fractional Tier 3 partner, delivering advanced Systems Administration, Infrastructure, Networking cloud, and security expertise to MSPs supporting diverse client environments.



Our engineers are trusted technical partners — leading implementations, resolving complex escalations, and working directly with MSP clients to execute real-world solutions. Our outbound team is the first voice those partners hear, and that first impression matters.



Role Overview



We are seeking an experienced Cold Caller / Outbound Appointment Setter to drive outbound prospecting into Managed Service Providers and IT firms across the United States. You will own the top of the funnel — building call lists, making high-volume outbound calls, handling objections in real time, and booking qualified discovery meetings for our leadership team.



This is a voice-first, customer-facing role. Native-level spoken English is a hard requirement, not a preference. You will be speaking with US-based business owners, IT directors, and MSP principals every day. Applicants with a noticeable accent that impedes clarity, or with hesitant, scripted-sounding delivery, will not be advanced.



This role requires resilience, independence, and the ability to hold a confident business conversation with senior technical decision-makers without a script to hide behind.



Key Responsibilities

Outbound Calling & Prospecting

Make a high volume of outbound cold calls per day to MSPs, IT service firms, and internal IT departments across US time zones.

Open conversations confidently with owners, principals, and IT decision-makers.

Qualify prospects against our ideal-client profile (company size, service mix, existing Tier 3 gaps).

Handle gatekeepers professionally and consistently reach the decision-maker.

Book qualified discovery calls and appointments directly onto the sales calendar.

Objection Handling & Conversation Quality

Respond to objections in real time without reading verbatim from a script.

Adapt tone and pacing to the person on the other end of the line.

Communicate our value proposition clearly to a technical audience without overstating technical claims.

Know when to disqualify a prospect quickly and move on.

Follow-Up & Pipeline Management

Execute structured follow-up sequences by phone,
, and LinkedIn.

Log every call, outcome, and next step accurately in the CRM the same day.

Maintain and clean prospect lists, correcting bad data as you encounter it.

Nurture "not right now" prospects on a defined callback cadence.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Report daily and weekly on dials, connects, conversations, and appointments set.

Participate in call reviews and act on coaching feedback.

Test and report on messaging, opening lines, and list segments.

Flag recurring objections and market feedback to leadership.

Availability & Support Expectations

Standard working hours are 10:00 AM–6:00 PM EST, Monday through Friday.

This is a night shift in the Philippines — roughly 11:00 PM to 7:00 AM Manila time. Please only apply if you have worked a graveyard schedule before and can sustain it long term.

Some flexibility is required during active campaigns or event-driven outreach.

This role is not on-call, but consistent attendance during US business hours is essential.

Qualifications

Required Experience

2+ years of outbound cold calling, appointment setting, or SDR experience into the US market.

Native-level or near-native English, spoken and written, with a neutral or American accent. Clear articulation, natural pacing, and confident phone presence are non-negotiable.

Proven ability to hold unscripted business conversations with senior decision-makers.

Demonstrated track record of hitting dial, conversation, and appointment-set targets.

Experience with CRM and dialer platforms (HubSpot, Go High Level, Close, Aircall, or similar).

Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet dedicated workspace, a backup power source, and a quality noise-cancelling headset.

Comfortable with rejection and high call volume; self-directed with minimal supervision.

Preferred Experience

Prior outbound experience selling into MSPs, IT services, or B2B technology.

Working familiarity with Microsoft 365, cloud, or managed IT terminology.

Experience building or sourcing prospect lists (Apollo, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).

Compensation

Base: $1,000 USD per month, paid twice monthly.

Appointment commission: $25 USD for every qualified appointment that shows.

Conversion bonus: $100 USD for every prospect who signs on for services after a meeting you booked.

No minimum threshold. Commission is paid from the first qualified appointment.



What counts as a qualified appointment:



The meeting must actually take place, and the person on the call must be a decision-maker or a decision-influencer — an owner, principal, partner, CEO, CTO, IT director, IT manager, service manager, or operations manager. A help desk technician, receptionist, or office administrator does not count, even if they agreed to the meeting.



Commission is paid on the meeting that actually happens. Reschedules do not affect the commission — if the meeting eventually takes place with a qualifying contact, it is paid. Appointments that are never held are not paid.



Conversion bonus:



If a prospect you booked signs a services agreement with T3 Tech Partners, you receive an additional $100 USD. The bonus is paid on signature, and it applies for 90 days from the date of your booked meeting, so you are still credited when a deal takes time to close.



What this adds up to:



At a normal pace of 15 to 20 held appointments per month, base plus appointment commission lands between $1,375 and $1,500. Two signed clients in a month brings that to roughly $1,600 to $1,700. There is no cap on the conversion bonus.



HOW TO APPLY — AUDIO SAMPLE REQUIRED



Applications without an audio sample will not be reviewed. This is the first thing we check.



Because this role is judged on how you sound on the phone, every applicant must submit a voice recording of 60 to 90 seconds. Record it yourself, in your own voice, in one take.



In your recording, please cover:



Your name and where you are based.

A brief summary of your outbound calling experience and the markets you have called into.

A live mock cold call opener: imagine you have just reached the owner of a US-based MSP who did not expect your call. Deliver your opening 20 to 30 seconds exactly as you would on a real dial.

How you would respond if that owner said, "We already have an internal engineer for that."



How to send it:



Record using any free app or tool you like, then paste the shareable link directly into the job post chat here on OnlineJobs.ph. Free options that work well:



Vocaroo (
) — record in your browser, no account needed, gives you an instant link.

Voice Spice (
) — browser-based recorder with a shareable link.

Clyp (
) — free hosting with a direct link.

Google Drive or Dropbox — record on your phone, upload, and share the link.



Make sure your link is set so that anyone with the link can listen. We cannot chase down permission requests, and locked links will be treated as no submission.



Along with your audio link, please include in the chat:



Your resume or a link to it.

The number of outbound dials you typically made per day in your last role.

Confirmation that you can work 10:00 AM–6:00 PM EST (11:00 PM–7:00 AM Manila time), and whether you have held a night shift role before.



We review every submission that includes an audio sample. Strong candidates will be invited to a short live phone screen — where, again, how you sound will matter most.

title: Level 3 Network Architect
description:
Network Engineer (Level 3) — On-Call / As-Needed



Location: Fully Remote (Ph) Schedule: As needed. You will be contacted via WhatsApp when advanced tickets requiring these skills come through. Hours: Availability during US East Coast business hours (EST) when engaged Engagement Type: Ongoing as-needed contractor — this is not a full-time salaried position Compensation: [RATE TO BE INSERTED]



About T3 Tech Partners



T3 Tech Partners is a US-based company and the team MSPs rely on when challenges exceed Tier 2 or internal expertise. We operate as a Fractional Tier 3 partner, delivering advanced Systems Administration, infrastructure, cloud, network, and security expertise to MSPs supporting diverse client environments.



Our engineers are trusted technical partners — leading implementations, resolving complex escalations, and working directly with MSP clients to execute real-world solutions.



Role Overview



We are seeking a senior-level Network Engineer to serve as an on-call escalation resource for complex networking issues across our MSP partners' client environments.



This is an as-needed engagement, not a scheduled full-time role. When an advanced network ticket comes through that requires this skill set, we will reach out to you directly via WhatsApp. You are expected to acknowledge quickly and, when you accept the work, engage during US East Coast business hours until the issue is resolved or handed back.



This structure suits someone who already has a primary role or an independent consulting practice and wants additional senior-level work on a flexible basis. It does not suit someone who needs guaranteed weekly hours or predictable income.



This role requires strong technical depth, independence, and the ability to step into an unfamiliar network with limited documentation and orient yourself quickly.



Key Responsibilities

Advanced Network Escalation Support

Take ownership of advanced and expert-level network escalations passed up from MSP Tier 1 and Tier 2 teams.

Diagnose complex connectivity, performance, latency, and packet loss issues across LAN, WAN, and hybrid environments.

Perform root-cause analysis and implement durable fixes rather than temporary workarounds.

Work directly with MSP technicians and, where required, end customers to execute resolutions.

Document findings, changes made, and recommendations at the close of every engagement.

Firewalls & Network Security

Configure, troubleshoot, and optimize enterprise firewalls including Fortinet FortiGate, SonicWall, Cisco, Meraki, Palo Alto, and similar platforms.

Design and troubleshoot site-to-site IPsec VPNs, SSL VPNs, and remote access solutions.

Implement network segmentation, VLAN isolation, and access control policies.

Configure and tune IDS/IPS, content filtering, geo-blocking, and threat protection features.

Review and remediate firewall rule bases for security and performance.

Routing, Switching & Wireless

Configure and troubleshoot managed switching including VLANs, trunking, spanning tree, link aggregation, QoS, and PoE.

Work with static routing, policy-based routing, and dynamic routing protocols (OSPF, BGP) as environments require.

Deploy, tune, and troubleshoot enterprise wireless environments (Meraki, Ubiquiti, Ruckus, Aruba, Cisco).

Perform wireless coverage, roaming, interference, and density troubleshooting.

Diagnose DNS, DHCP, NAT, and IP addressing issues.

WAN, Circuits & Cloud Connectivity

Troubleshoot ISP circuits, hand-offs, and carrier issues, and manage escalations with providers.

Configure and support SD-WAN deployments, failover, and multi-WAN load balancing.

Build and troubleshoot hybrid connectivity into Azure, including virtual networks, VPN gateways, and site-to-site tunnels.

Support network requirements for Microsoft 365 workloads, including QoS for Teams voice and video.

Assist with network cutovers, ISP migrations, and office relocations.

Analysis & Documentation

Perform packet captures and protocol analysis (Wireshark or equivalent) to isolate difficult issues.

Produce or update network diagrams, IP schemes, and configuration documentation as part of engagement close-out.

Provide clear written summaries that an MSP Tier 2 technician can act on and learn from.

Recommend standards and long-term improvements to MSP partners where appropriate.

Availability & Engagement Expectations

You will be contacted via WhatsApp when a qualifying ticket comes in. Acknowledgement is expected within a reasonable window during US East Coast business hours.

You are free to decline any individual engagement, but consistent unavailability will end the arrangement.

When you accept an engagement, you are expected to work it through to resolution or to a clean hand-off.

Some work may fall outside standard hours for maintenance windows, cutovers, or critical outages. These are scheduled in advance where possible.

Volume varies. Some weeks will bring multiple escalations, others none.

Qualifications

Required Experience

5+ years of hands-on network engineering experience, with significant time in an MSP or multi-client environment.

Expert-level proficiency with enterprise firewall platforms (Fortinet, SonicWall, Cisco, Meraki, Palo Alto, or comparable).

Strong command of routing and switching fundamentals, VLANs, VPN technologies, and network troubleshooting methodology.

Demonstrated ability to resolve issues that Tier 2 teams could not.

Experience with packet capture and protocol-level analysis.

Comfort working in unfamiliar environments with incomplete documentation.

Excellent native-level English communication, written and verbal. You will be speaking directly with US-based MSP technicians and client stakeholders, often under pressure during an outage.

Reliable high-speed internet, a backup power source, and a quiet workspace suitable for client calls.

Proven experience working in MSP environments (required).

Preferred Experience

Relevant certifications (Fortinet NSE, Cisco CCNP, Meraki CMNA, Palo Alto PCNSE, or similar).

Azure networking and hybrid cloud connectivity experience.

SD-WAN design and deployment experience.

VoIP and unified communications network troubleshooting.

Familiarity with Microsoft 365 network requirements and optimization.

Scripting or automation experience for network configuration and auditing.

HOW TO APPLY



Please reply in the job post chat here on OnlineJobs.ph with the following:



Your resume or a link to it.

A specific example of a network escalation you resolved that another team could not. Describe the symptoms, how you isolated the cause, and what you did to fix it. Two or three paragraphs is enough. This is the part we read most closely.

The firewall platforms you have the deepest experience with, and roughly how many deployments you have worked on for each.

Your hourly rate in USD.

Confirmation that you can be reached via WhatsApp and can engage during US East Coast business hours.

Any relevant certifications, with dates.



Candidates who move forward will complete a live technical conversation over video. Please be prepared to talk through your troubleshooting approach without notes.

title: Video Editing Assistant (CapCut) – Instagram Reels Variations
description:
I am looking for a reliable video editing assistant to create variations of completed short-form videos for Instagram Trial Reels, and to edit simple talking videos with image overlays.



This is a part-time, straightforward, repeatable editing job — approximately 1–2 hours per day, 6 days a week. You will work inside a shared CapCut space and a shared Google Drive. Most videos are one minute long or shorter.



TASK 1: STORYTELLING VARIATIONS (6 PER DAY)



You'll create new variations of completed storytelling videos by swapping clips, using the swap clips provided. The number of swaps will vary depending on the video and will be specified in the guide or your daily instructions.



Depending on the video, you may also make small changes such as:

- Horizontally flipping sections of the video that do not contain text

- Slightly zooming in or changing the framing

- Adding a 0.1-second black screen at the beginning

- Changing the font or text style

- Making minor adjustments to saturation, exposure, brightness, or filters

- Slightly shifting the audio volume up or down



The goal of these edits is to make each variation look "fresh" to the algorithm.



TASK 2: "LET ME GUESS" VIDEOS (4–5 PER DAY)



You'll receive raw talking videos (usually around 1 minute or less) that all follow the same simple format. You'll cut out all dead space and pauses, then add the provided image overlays at the moment each point is said. Images will be numbered in order in Google Drive. The pacing and style are the same every time, so once you've done a few, these are quick.



For both tasks, you'll export each video, name it correctly, and upload it to the correct Google Drive folder.



This is not advanced video editing. You'll be swapping clips, making small adjustments, and doing simple cuts and overlays following a set format.



A full guide with exact instructions and examples will be provided. Attention to detail matters, so include the word "Trial" somewhere in the middle of your application when describing your editing experience.



REQUIREMENTS:

- Experience using CapCut (desktop preferred)

- Strong attention to detail

- Ability to follow instructions exactly

- Reliable communication

- Fast internet and the ability to upload video files

- Organized file management

- Consistent daily availability (about 1–2 hours/day, 6 days/week)



TO APPLY, PLEASE INCLUDE:

1. The editing software you use

2. Your daily availability

3. Your experience editing short-form videos

4. A link to previous editing work

5. Confirmation that you are comfortable with pay of $180 USD per month for this role (approx. 1–2 hours/day, 6 days a week), increasing to $220 USD per month after a successful first month



Selected applicants will be asked to complete a short paid test.

title: Marketing and Data Specialist
description:
ABOUT INTERCEPTLY



Interceptly helps B2B companies find and start conversations with buyers who are already showing intent. We run signal-driven outbound campaigns for our clients and our partners' clients, and we build our own intent products, including LeadIntercept, which tracks competitor engagement at the individual level.



We are a small team that runs on AI. Most of our processes live as Claude Code skills in a shared Git repo, and our data lives in Airtable and GoHighLevel. You will be one of the people who keeps that machine running and makes it better.



THE ROLE



This is a hands-on role split across 2 areas:



1. Marketing in GoHighLevel and on our website. You own our GHL marketing setup, our blog and help center content, and our site's SEO health.

2. Data. You own the prospect data and intent signal data that feeds our clients' campaigns, from sourcing and cleaning it to classifying it in Airtable and loading it into live campaigns.



Claude Code sits across both. You will use it every day to write content, process data, and run our internal skills, and you will maintain and improve those skills as our processes change.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



GoHighLevel marketing and operations

- Own our GoHighLevel workspaces: contacts, custom fields, pipelines, tasks,
 templates, snippets, and workflows

- Complete our platform consolidation into GHL, including rebuilding onboarding and partner forms as GHL surveys and forms from existing build specs

- Build and maintain
 campaigns, broadcasts, and automation workflows (onboarding flows, check-ins, billing reminders, re-engagement)

- Publish and maintain help center articles in GHL and keep the support bot's knowledge base current

- Keep contact data clean and segmentable so marketing and client success can rely on it



Website, content, and SEO

- Write and publish blog posts on our WordPress site (Elementor), following our content calendar and brand voice

- Set Yoast meta titles and descriptions, featured images, categories, and internal links on every post

- Write and schedule company page social posts and share new content across the team's accounts

- Run regular Ahrefs site audits and fix what they find: broken links, redirects, canonicals, meta length, orphan pages, missing OG images

- Monitor Google Search Console for indexing problems and work through the fix list

- Keep product naming and brand rules consistent everywhere we publish



Data and intent signal operations

- Source and qualify prospect lists using sales intelligence tools against each client's ICP and campaign angles

- Clean, dedupe, and sense-check lists before they go anywhere near a live campaign

- Load qualified prospects into client campaigns in the Interceptly platform and track volumes per campaign

- Run our weekly intent signal cycle: assign and classify competitor engagement signals in Airtable, maintain signal views for each client, and share weekly signal reviews with clients

- Coordinate tracked profiles with our external platform team

- Investigate data quality problems (low match rates, excluded signals, missing records) and recommend filter or ICP changes

- Maintain our Airtable bases: views, fields, linked records, and campaign options



Claude Code and automation

- Use Claude Code daily to draft content, process data, update client files, and run our internal skills (blog publishing, signal classification, campaign content, presentation decks)

- Maintain and improve skills as processes change, commit changes to GitHub, and tell the team what changed

- Feed call transcripts and onboarding responses into our client knowledge base so client files stay current

- Spot manual, repeated work and turn it into a skill or workflow



Campaign support

- Help our campaign manager build and launch client campaigns, update campaign content and sequences, and format Gamma decks for client review

- Send routine client updates (new data added, signal summaries, campaign launches) when asked



A TYPICAL WEEK



- Every day: share your priorities in the morning and an end-of-day update with the team. Load new data into campaigns, handle GHL tasks, and push content forward.

- Midweek: intent signal assignment and weekly signal reviews for every active client.

- Weekly: at least one blog post published and shared, plus company page posts.

- Every 2 to 4 weeks: Ahrefs site audit and fixes.

- As needed: client calls alongside the campaign manager, new client onboarding data, skill updates.



WHAT YOU WILL NEED



Must have

- 2+ years in a marketing operations, data, or growth role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company or agency

- Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel, or a similar CRM and marketing automation platform such as HubSpot, with a willingness to get deep into GHL quickly

- Strong Airtable skills: views, filters, linked records, field types, and keeping a base tidy

- Regular use of Claude or another AI assistant for real work, not just casual prompts. You should be comfortable writing clear instructions, reviewing output critically, and catching mistakes

- WordPress experience, including publishing posts, working with a page builder (Elementor preferred), and handling SEO fields

- Working knowledge of technical SEO and a tool like Ahrefs or Semrush: you know what a canonical, a 301, and an orphan page are, and how to fix them

- Excellent written English. You will write content that goes out under our name

- Real attention to detail with data. Putting 500 wrong prospects into a campaign is worse than putting in none



Nice to have

- Experience with Claude Code, GitHub, or working from the command line

- Experience with B2B prospecting tools and building lists against an ICP

- Familiarity with intent data or outbound campaigns

- Gamma, Google Search Console, or Slack automation experience

- Some client-facing experience, or confidence to build it



HOW WE WORK



- We document everything. If you do something twice, it should end up in our knowledge base or a skill.

- We are async-first, but we expect daily overlap with UK hours for the team meeting and client work.

- You will get a structured handover, plus access to our SOPs, playbooks, and skills repo.

title: AI FINANCE BOT TRAINER
description:
Welcome to Project Vertex (Preferred Finance Background but Not Mandatory)



On Project Vertex, you are invited to create challenges that AI models would struggle to solve. Use your finance and accounting expertise to build questions that force a model to chain several real look-ups and exact calculations together — questions it cannot answer from memory or a single search.



For each task you deliver three things: a prompt (the question the model will see), a reasoning chain (your step-by-step proof of the answer, with every source and citation), and a rubric (the grading key). A model attempts your question while you work — your question only counts once you have stumped it.

title: Google Ads, Performance Max, & YouTube Growth Expert
description:
# Google Ads & YouTube Growth Expert



### PPC • YouTube • Google AI • Performance Max • Lead Generation



**Troy Curtis Entertainment (TCE)** is looking for an experienced **Google Ads & YouTube Growth Expert** to help us build and scale a serious paid acquisition system.



We are a luxury live entertainment company specializing in **weddings, corporate events, galas, private celebrations and destination events.**



We already have strong video content, testimonials, reviews, a proven sales process and high-value services.



Now we want to **dominate Google and YouTube.**



We are NOT looking for someone who simply knows how to set up basic Google Search campaigns.



We want someone who understands **where Google Ads is going today**, including Google's AI-powered advertising ecosystem.



## What You'll Be Responsible For



### Google Search



Build and optimize high-intent campaigns around searches such as:



* Wedding bands

* Luxury wedding entertainment

* Live wedding bands

* NYC wedding bands

* Miami wedding bands

* Corporate event entertainment

* Private party entertainment

* Destination wedding entertainment

* And other high-value search terms



You'll manage:



* Keyword strategy

* Search intent

* Match types

* Negative keywords

* Ad copy

* Landing pages

* Geographic targeting

* Bidding

* Search-term analysis

* Conversion optimization



### YouTube Ads



We have a large library of video content and want to turn it into a **customer acquisition machine.**



You'll help us develop:



* YouTube Ads

* YouTube Shorts

* Video campaigns

* Retargeting

* Audience targeting

* Creative testing

* Geographic targeting

* High-value audience strategies

* Video-viewer remarketing



### Performance Max



We want someone who actually understands how to use **Performance Max strategically**, including:



* Conversion signals

* Audience signals

* Creative assets

* Search themes

* Negative keywords

* Conversion values

* New customer acquisition

* Campaign structure

* Budget allocation

* Optimization



### Demand Gen & Google's AI



We want someone familiar with Google's newer advertising products and AI-driven systems, including:



* Demand Gen

* AI Max for Search

* Performance Max

* YouTube/Shorts

* Google AI-powered search

* First-party audiences

* Remarketing

* Value-based bidding



You don't need to be an expert in every new Google product, but you **must be someone who stays ahead of what's changing.**



## Tracking & Attribution



This is extremely important.



We don't care about clicks and impressions if they don't produce business.



You should understand:



* Google Analytics 4

* Google Tag Manager

* Conversion tracking

* Enhanced conversions

* Call tracking

* Form tracking

* Offline conversion tracking

* CRM integrations

* Lead-quality tracking

* Revenue attribution

* UTM tracking



Our ultimate goal is to track:



**Lead → Qualified Lead → Consultation → Proposal → Booked Event → Revenue**



We want Google optimizing toward **real customers and revenue**, not just cheap leads.



## Local & Multi-Market Growth



Experience with:



* Google Business Profile

* Google Maps

* Local SEO

* City-specific landing pages

* Geographic campaigns

* Multi-market strategies



is a major plus.



We plan to expand TCE into multiple major markets, so we want someone who understands how to scale geographically.



## Who We're Looking For



You are:



* Experienced with Google Ads

* Experienced with YouTube Ads

* Analytical and data-driven

* Creative

* Comfortable with AI

* Constantly testing

* Focused on conversions and revenue

* Comfortable with high-ticket lead generation

* A strong problem solver

* Someone who stays current with Google's changes



Experience with **weddings, luxury events, entertainment, hospitality or other high-ticket services** is a major plus.



## Not a Good Fit If...



You're primarily experienced with:



* Boosting social media posts

* Basic PPC setup

* Managing campaigns without testing

* Reporting clicks and impressions

* Optimizing only for cheap leads

* Following basic Google Ads tutorials



We want someone who can **think strategically and execute.**



## What Success Looks Like



We want to know:



**How much did we spend?**



**How many qualified leads did we generate?**



**How many consultations happened?**



**How many events did we book?**



**How much revenue did we generate?**



Our goal is to build a **scalable Google acquisition engine**, not simply "run ads."



## How To Apply



Please send:



**1. Your experience**



Tell us about 2–3 Google Ads accounts you've managed. Include the industry, monthly spend and results.



**2. Your experience with:**



* Google Search

* YouTube

* Performance Max

* Demand Gen

* GA4

* Google Tag Manager

* Conversion tracking

* Offline conversions

* CRM attribution



**3. Your Loom video**



Please send a **3–5 minute Loom video** answering:



> **"If you were taking over Google Ads for TCE, a luxury wedding and event entertainment company, what would you do first and why?"**



We want to see **how you think**, not just hear about your experience.



**4. Your availability and monthly rate**



Please include your preferred working hours and expected monthly compensation.



### Important



We're not looking for someone to simply **manage Google Ads.**



We're looking for someone who can help us **build a Google and YouTube growth engine.**



If you understand Google deeply, stay ahead of Google's AI developments, know how to use video to generate demand, and care about **revenue instead of vanity metrics**, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Video Editor and Graphic Designer
description:
About us



Hüga Collective makes hygge-inspired home lighting, centered on paper lamps that turn any room into the coziest corner of the house. We're a small, scrappy DTC team on Shopify, and social is how most people discover us. We're looking for someone who can make warm light stop the scroll.



The role



You'll be our go-to creative for short-form video and design. Working closely with our Marketing Manager, you'll turn content plans into Reels, TikToks, and graphics that people watch, share, and save. Our goal is simple: create content that goes viral and grows the brand. This isn't a "wait for a brief" role. We want someone who brings ideas, owns the outcome, and is always chasing the next breakout video.



What you'll do



- Partner with the Marketing Manager to plan and execute content, from monthly calendars to quick-turn trend reactions

- Pitch original creative concepts and formats, not just edit what you're handed

- Edit short-form video for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and paid social, from raw footage to a polished, platform-native cut

- Write multiple hook variations for each idea so we can test what works

- Build ad variations (different hooks, captions, pacing, CTAs) from a single shoot

- Design static and motion graphics: social posts, carousels, ad creatives, story frames, and on-screen text

- Track how your content performs, learn from it, and double down on what's working

- Keep up with trends, sounds, and formats, and know which ones fit a cozy lighting brand and which don't



Who you are



- Creative first. You have a constant stream of ideas and a point of view. You see a paper lamp and think of ten ways to film it.

- Ownership mindset. You treat our channels like your own. You don't stop at "delivered." You care whether it worked, and you figure out why when it didn't.

- Social native. You speak the language: hooks, pattern interrupts, pacing, captions, trending audio, UGC-style edits.

- Collaborative. You take feedback well, push back with good reasons, and make the Marketing Manager's plans better.

- Fast and organized. You can juggle multiple projects without dropping the quality bar.



What you bring



- 3+ years editing short-form social video, ideally for DTC or e-commerce brands

- A portfolio of Reels/TikToks you've edited, with view counts or results if you have them

- Strong graphic design skills and a good eye for typography and layout

- Proficiency in Premiere Pro or CapCut (After Effects is a plus) and Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva

- Taste. You know the difference between cozy and cluttered.



Nice to have



- At least one video you've made that went viral (tell us about it)

- Experience making paid social ad creative and testing variations

- A love of interiors, lighting, or slow-living aesthetics



How we'll measure success

First 90 days



Publishing 5 short-form videos per week across TikTok and Reels

Every concept delivered with at least 3 hook variations

Average 3-second hook rate of 25%+ across organic videos

At least one video reaching 5K+ views



First 6 months



At least one video reaching 20k+ views

20% growth in TikTok and Instagram followers

At least 10% of your ad creatives become top performers in our paid campaigns

A repeatable content format or series that consistently outperforms our average

 Hours:** 30 to 35 hours per week.

s, or lingering issues at the end of your shift.

Exceptional English:** You possess a flawless, neutral spoken English accent and are completely confident handling outbound phone calls to US-based clients and contractors.

title: SEO Manager & Content Creator
description:
SEO Manager & Content Creator

Working Hours: Australian Business Hours (Starting at 7:00 AM PHT)

We are looking for a forward-thinking SEO Manager & Content Creator who understands that the search landscape has evolved. If you know how to balance the art of high-quality human writing with the efficiency of AI-assisted workflows—and you're ready for the era of AI search—we want you on our team.



At our core, we deeply value loyalty and efficient work. We don't believe in clock-watching or stretching out tasks just to look busy; we reward smart, impactful execution, accountability, and long-term commitment. Working remotely from the Philippines during Australian business hours, you will collaborate closely with our graphic designers to create, optimize, and maintain websites that don’t just look good, but actively convert traffic into sales.



What You’ll Be Doing

Create & Optimize Content: Craft high-converting, deeply engaging content. Using AI for brainstorms and initial ideas is perfectly fine, provided articles are human-edited, refined, and expanded far beyond basic AI outputs. Every article must pass AI content detectors.



Drive Accountability & Growth: Take full responsibility for performance. Your efforts need to directly result in measurable increases in both organic traffic and conversions.



Build Websites That Sell: Partner with our graphic design team to co-create high-performing web pages. You bring the SEO blueprints and data; they bring the visuals.



Manage the Google Ecosystem: Take full ownership of our Google stack (GTM, GA4, GSC, Google Ads, PageSpeed Insights) to track user journeys, monitor site health, and run targeted visibility campaigns.



Audit & Revamp: Use advanced crawling and keyword tools (Search Atlas, Ubersuggest, or equivalent) to audit existing pages and product listings, fixing technical bottlenecks and breathing new life into older content.



Future-Proof Search Presence: Optimize our digital footprint for modern search algorithms as well as GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AIO (AI Optimization).



Essential Skills & Qualifications

Core Experience & Proven Track Record (Mandatory)



3+ Years in the Trenches: Minimum of 3 years of dedicated experience successfully managing both SEO strategy and content creation.



Proven Results: You must be able to clearly demonstrate a history of significantly increasing website traffic and conversions. Data-backed proof of your abilities is mandatory to be shortlisted. We are after an established professional—if you are just beginning your SEO journey, you will not have the required experience for this role.



Content & Strategy



Authentic Content Creation: Exceptional copywriting skills focused on human-first content that builds trust and drives action.



AI Balance & Strict Quality Control: Smart use of AI frameworks for research and ideas, paired with the human polish required to add depth, originality, and ensure 100% pass rates on AI checkers.



Next-Gen SEO: A solid working understanding of GEO and AIO to ensure our brand shows up in AI overviews and LLM responses.



Technical & Analytics Stack



Mastery of Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics (GA4), Google Search Console (GSC), Google Ads, and PageSpeed Insights.



Daily hands-on experience with Search Atlas and Ubersuggest (or equivalent keyword tools).



Logistics & Work Ethic



A reliable, long-term team player who works efficiently, respects deadlines, and takes accountability for metrics.



Ability to commit to 30 to 35 hours per week, working reliably during Australian business hours with a sharp 7:00 AM PHT start.



What’s in It for You?

Generous Performance Bonuses: We heavily reward impact. Successful execution of SEO strategies and high-performing campaigns tie directly into a generous bonus scheme.



100% Remote Flexibility: Work entirely from home while collaborating with an international, fast-moving team.



Cutting-Edge Environment: Work with a team that embraces modern tech, AI tools, and forward-looking SEO strategies rather than outdated, rigid playbooks.



How to Apply (Please Read Carefully)

Please do not reply with an AI-generated answer. Keep your response brief, personalized, and to the point.



To be considered for the shortlist, your application must include:

title: AI-Assisted Full-Stack Builder – German Voice Agents, Mobile Apps & Client Websites
description:
nüll is a German digital agency building websites, applications, and AI-powered customer-acquisition systems for tradespeople, consultants, law firms, and local businesses across Germany.



We are looking for a resourceful AI-assisted full-stack builder who can figure things out, learn unfamiliar tools quickly, debug problems, and ship complete working products. We actively use Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, ChatGPT, and other AI development tools. You do not need to know every platform before starting, but you must understand code well enough to review, test, secure, and improve AI-generated work.



This is not a role for someone who waits for detailed step-by-step instructions. You should be comfortable reading documentation, testing APIs, solving blockers independently, and taking a project from idea to production.



THE THREE TYPES OF WORK



1. German AI Call Agents

You will build German-speaking AI telephone agents for tradespeople and local-business owners. Use cases may include inbound call answering, lead qualification, appointment booking, missed-call recovery, FAQs, follow-up, call transfers, and CRM updates.



You should be able to research and work with platforms such as Vapi, Retell AI, Twilio, ElevenLabs, OpenAI Realtime, or comparable tools. You must be able to connect telephony, speech recognition, German text-to-speech, webhooks, calendars, CRMs, databases, and analytics.



The call experience must work naturally in German. You should be able to test pronunciation, latency, interruptions, silence, dates, phone numbers, names, addresses, appointment flows, transfers, and failure handling. Perfect German fluency is helpful but not mandatory if you can work accurately with supplied German scripts and our German-speaking reviewer. GDPR-aware implementation and safe handling of recordings, transcripts, and customer data are required.



2. Real Mobile Applications

You must have contributed to at least one real mobile application currently available on the Apple App Store. Live App Store links are mandatory.



We need proof of what you personally built. For every app you submit, explain your exact role, technologies used, features implemented, and whether you handled TestFlight, App Store Connect, signing, release management, or production maintenance.



Relevant experience may include React Native, Flutter, native iOS, authentication, APIs, databases, push notifications, subscriptions, payments, analytics, and crash reporting. Screenshots, Figma designs, tutorials, local demos, and unfinished prototypes do not replace a live App Store application.



3. Client Websites

You will build polished, conversion-focused websites for our German clients, similar in quality to the work our current developer Raemer produces.



You should be comfortable with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, APIs, GitHub, and Vercel. Typical projects include responsive 5–10 page business websites, landing pages, lead forms, booking flows,
 notifications, CRM integrations, analytics, conversion tracking, technical SEO, and performance optimization.



You must have enough visual judgment to turn a brief or reference into an original, professional design without always receiving a complete Figma file. The result must be responsive, tested, maintainable, and ready for a real client—not an unfinished AI-generated prototype.



HOW WE WORK

• Use AI coding tools to increase speed while remaining responsible for the final result

• Research unfamiliar APIs and platforms independently

• Communicate blockers early and provide concise progress updates

• Connect billed hours to visible tasks and deliverables

• Test your own work before requesting review

• Deliver source code to agency-owned GitHub repositories

• Document setup, environment variables, integrations, and deployment

• Protect client information and credentials

• Do not subcontract work without approval



WHO SHOULD APPLY

We care more about shipped products, practical judgment, and problem-solving ability than formal titles. You should apply if you can demonstrate that you have built real products, understand the code you produce, and can figure out unfamiliar technical problems as you go.



Do not apply if your experience consists mainly of tutorials, certificates, school projects, copied templates, WordPress page building, or AI-generated demos that were never used in production.



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS

Begin your application with the word BERLIN. Answer every question directly and number your answers. Generic applications without proof will be skipped.



1. Attach or link your current résumé/CV.

2. Provide direct links to all Apple App Store applications you personally helped build. For each app, state your exact contribution and the technologies used.

3. Did you personally handle TestFlight, App Store Connect, signing, releases, or production maintenance? Explain.

4. Provide a live demo, recording, or case study of an AI voice or telephone agent you built. State the telephony, voice, model, and integration stack.

5. Have you built a German-speaking call agent? If yes, provide evidence. If not, explain exactly how you would build and test one.

6. Explain how you would test German pronunciation, interruptions, dates, phone numbers, addresses, appointment booking, call transfers, and failure handling.

7. Provide at least five live websites you personally developed. Explain what you built on each website.

8. Describe your experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, Supabase, APIs, GitHub, and Vercel.

9. Which AI coding tools do you use, and describe one difficult problem you solved with them.

10. Give an example of a technology you did not know beforehand but successfully learned and shipped.

11. Confirm your time zone, weekly availability, expected compensation, and earliest starting date.



Portfolio ownership and technical claims will be verified during a live interview using hypothetical scenarios and discussion of your existing work. There is no paid trial task.

title: Systems Administrator
description:
Location: Fully Remote (Ph)

Schedule: As Needed, will message via whatsapp when advanced tickets requiring these skills come through. US based company, working US east coast hours.



About T3 Tech Partners



T3 Tech Partners is the team MSPs rely on when challenges exceed Tier 2 or internal expertise. We operate as a Fractional Tier 3 partner, delivering advanced Microsoft 365, cloud, and security expertise to MSPs supporting diverse client environments.

Our engineers are trusted technical partners — leading implementations, resolving complex escalations, and working directly with MSP clients to execute real-world solutions.

________________________________________

Role Overview

We are seeking a senior-level Cloud Solutions Engineer (Level 3) to lead advanced Microsoft 365 and cloud initiatives, handle complex escalations, and implement solutions directly with MSP clients. This is a technical, customer-facing role — while not sales-focused, you will regularly work directly with customers to design and implement the solutions required to meet their business and technical needs.

This role requires strong technical depth, independence, and the ability to step into unfamiliar environments and software ecosystems with confidence.

________________________________________

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Cloud & Escalation Support

• Handle advanced and expert-level escalations related to cloud infrastructure and SaaS services.

• Serve as a senior escalation point for Microsoft 365 and cloud-related issues across multiple MSP environments.

• Perform root-cause analysis and implement long-term remediation for complex or recurring issues.

• Work directly with MSP clients and end customers to execute solutions and improvements.



Microsoft 365 (Core Focus Area)

• Architect, deploy, optimize, and support Microsoft 365 environments end-to-end, including:

o Exchange Online (mail flow, security, migrations, troubleshooting)

o SharePoint Online and OneDrive (architecture, permissions, governance, performance, migrations)

o Microsoft Teams (policies, governance, troubleshooting)

• Perform and lead tenant-to-tenant migrations, including email, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams data.

• Execute server-to-cloud migrations, such as file servers to SharePoint or OneDrive.

• Expert-level administration and troubleshooting of:

o Microsoft Intune (endpoint management, compliance policies, configuration profiles, application deployment, Autopilot)

o Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) including identity lifecycle, SSO, MFA, and hybrid identity

o Conditional Access policy design and enforcement

o Microsoft Defender (Endpoint, Office 365, Identity)

o Microsoft Purview (data governance, retention, compliance, DLP)

• Implement and maintain Microsoft 365 security best practices across client tenants.

• Assist MSPs with tenant configuration, licensing strategy, and feature utilization.



Third-Party Application Integration

• Work with third-party software applications that integrate with Microsoft 365 
, identity, security, document management, line-of-business platforms).

• Support applications you may not have prior experience with, requiring:

o Willingness to learn new platforms quickly

o Ability to understand how third-party systems interact with Microsoft 365

o Troubleshooting authentication, permissions, data flow, and integration issues

• Collaborate with vendors and MSPs to ensure proper configuration and supportability.



Server and Infrastructure Support

• Administer and troubleshoot Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and File Services.

• Manage and support virtualization platforms (e.g., Hyper-V, VMware) in on-premises and hybrid configurations.

• Perform server migrations, including lift-and-shift to Azure, P2V conversions, and workload transitions to cloud-hosted services.

• Support and maintain backup and disaster recovery solutions, ensuring recoverability for both on-premises and cloud workloads.

• Assist with decommissioning legacy on-premises infrastructure as part of cloud migration projects.



Projects, Optimization & Automation

• Lead cloud migration and optimization projects for MSP clients.

• Optimize Microsoft 365 environments for security, performance, and cost efficiency.

• Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to automate Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, and related administrative tasks.

• Recommend improvements, standards, and long-term strategies to MSP partners.

• Stay current on Microsoft 365 feature changes and emerging cloud technologies.

Availability & Support Expectations

• Standard working hours are 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST.

• Some flexibility is required for high-impact client issues, critical changes, or migrations outside normal hours.

• This role is not on-call, but responsiveness during critical events is expected.

________________________________________

Qualifications

Required Experience

• 5+ years of hands-on experience with cloud solutions in an MSP or multi-tenant environment.

• Expert-level proficiency in:

o Microsoft 365 (all major workloads and admin portals)

o Microsoft Intune

o Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)

o Conditional Access and MFA

o Microsoft Defender and Purview

• Strong experience with:

o Tenant-to-tenant Microsoft 365 migrations

o Server-to-cloud migrations (e.g., file servers to SharePoint/OneDrive)

o Email and data migrations

• Required experience with PowerShell for administration and automation.

• Experience with Google Workspace and cross-platform migrations.

• Expert-level understanding of SaaS security and cloud cost optimization.

• General knowledge of infrastructure and networking concepts.

• Proven experience working in MSP environments (required).

• Excellent native-level English communication skills, both written and verbal.

title: Higgsfield AI Video Specialist – Consistent Character & Reaction Videos
description:
I’m looking for an experienced AI video creator who is highly skilled with Higgsfield and AI-generated video workflows.



The first project is to create a realistic AI person and produce approximately 50 short videos (around 15 seconds each) featuring the SAME consistent person.

The videos should look as if the person is sitting in front of a computer and being recorded through a normal webcam. I do NOT want a cinematic or overly polished camera look — the goal is realistic webcam-style footage.

In each video, the person should initially be looking naturally at the computer/screen and then suddenly react with a very surprised and happy/excited expression, as if they have just seen something amazing on their computer.



The most important requirements are:

• Strong experience with Higgsfield

• Experience creating realistic AI humans

• Excellent character consistency across many videos

• Ability to create natural facial expressions and believable reactions

• Ability to control camera angle, framing, lighting and movement

• Ability to reproduce a realistic webcam / computer-camera look

• Experience with AI video prompting and iteration

• Ability to mass-produce videos efficiently while maintaining consistent quality



For the first project, I need around 50 variations of the same person, with different surprised/happy reactions while keeping the character, environment and overall appearance consistent.



This can become a long-term position. After the first batch, I will need additional AI characters, more reaction styles and larger quantities of videos.



I will pay separately for all required Higgsfield credits / AI generation costs / platform costs, so these expenses should NOT come out of your salary.



When applying, please include:

1. Examples of AI-generated human videos you have created.

2. Examples specifically made with Higgsfield, if available.

3. Which AI video tools you currently use.

4. Your experience maintaining the same character across many videos.

5. Approximately how long you think it would take you to produce 50 approved 15-second videos.

6. Your expected hourly rate or project rate.



Please start your application with the word HIGGSFIELD so I know you read the full job description.

I am looking for someone experienced who can develop a reliable workflow with me, not someone experimenting with Higgsfield for the first time.

title: Full-Time Wedding Highlight Film Editor - Garrett Museau Photography & Cinematography
description:
Wedding Highlight Film Editor



Garrett Museau Photography & Cinematography



Position: Wedding Highlight Film Editor

Work Type: Full-Time 

Work Arrangement: Remote

Production Volume: Minimum 1 wedding film per week



About the Role



Garrett Museau Photography & Cinematography is looking for a talented and reliable Wedding Highlight Film Editor to join our post-production team.



The ideal candidate has a strong eye for storytelling, pacing, music, emotion, and cinematic visuals. You will take professionally captured wedding footage and transform it into polished approximately 10-minute highlight films that capture the emotion, energy, and story of each couple's wedding day.



This role is ideal for an editor who understands wedding cinematography and can work independently while consistently meeting deadlines and maintaining the creative quality of our brand.



Key Responsibilities



- Edit at least one wedding highlight film per week

- Create approximately 10-minute cinematic wedding highlight films

- Review and organize large amounts of wedding footage

- Build a compelling story from the wedding day from preparation through reception

- Select the strongest and most emotionally impactful footage

- Create smooth, cinematic transitions and pacing

- Sync and edit dialogue, vows, speeches, interviews, and natural audio

- Incorporate music to enhance the emotion and storytelling

- Perform professional color correction and color grading

- Clean and mix dialogue, speeches, vows, music, and ambient audio

- Maintain consistent visual and audio quality throughout each film

- Incorporate drone footage and multiple camera angles when applicable

- Create engaging opening sequences and memorable endings

- Export final films in formats appropriate for YouTube and other platforms

- Create YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and other short-form social media content from wedding footage

- Make revisions based on creative direction and client requirements

- Maintain organized project files and media

- Communicate consistently regarding project status, deadlines, and revisions



Required Qualifications



- Extensive knowledge and experience with DaVinci Resolve

- Proven experience editing wedding films, highlight films, or cinematic event films

- Ability to consistently complete at least one approximately 10-minute film per week

- Strong understanding of cinematic storytelling and visual pacing

- Strong knowledge of color correction and professional color grading

- Strong audio editing and mixing skills

- Ability to work with multi-camera footage

- Experience working with high-resolution footage and large media files

- Ability to create engaging YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels

- Strong attention to detail

- Excellent time-management and organizational skills

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

- Reliable communication and responsiveness



Preferred Qualifications



- Experience editing Sony camera footage

- Experience working with S-Log/S-Log3 and other log footage

- Experience with LUTs and professional color workflows

- Experience editing drone footage

- Experience with cinematic wedding storytelling

- Understanding of social media trends and short-form video pacing

- Previous experience working with professional wedding photography/cinematography companies

- Portfolio demonstrating wedding films and/or cinematic event work



What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who can tell a story, not simply assemble clips.



Our ideal editor understands that a great wedding film should feel emotional, intentional, and cinematic. You should know how to build anticipation, create emotional moments, use speeches and vows effectively, and maintain the viewer's attention throughout the entire film.



Reliability is extremely important. We need an editor who can consistently take on a minimum of one film per week, meet established deadlines, communicate throughout the editing process, and maintain a high standard of quality from project to project.



Portfolio Requirement



Applicants should provide a portfolio showcasing their editing abilities.



Please include:



- Wedding highlight films

- Cinematic event films, if applicable

- Short-form content/Reels/YouTube Shorts

- Examples demonstrating color grading

- Examples demonstrating audio editing

- Any other work that demonstrates your storytelling ability



Equipment & Software



Required:



- DaVinci Resolve — advanced/extensive proficiency

- Reliable computer capable of handling professional 4K video editing

- Reliable high-speed internet connection

- Adequate storage and backup capabilities for large video projects



Please submit:



- Resume or brief professional background

- Editing portfolio

- At least 2–3 wedding films or relevant cinematic projects

- Examples of Reels/Shorts, if available

- Your experience with DaVinci Resolve

- Your typical turnaround time for a 10-minute wedding highlight film

- Your weekly editing capacity

- Your preferred rate per film



Garrett Museau Photography & Cinematography is looking for a long-term editing partner who can become an integral part of our post-production team and help us deliver beautiful wedding films to our couples consistently and professionally.

title: Real Estate Compliance & Transaction Support Virtual Assistant
description:
# Real Estate Compliance & Transaction Support Virtual Assistant



**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Industry:** U.S. Real Estate Brokerage  

**Position Type:** Virtual Assistant / Long-Term Opportunity



We are a growing U.S.-based real estate brokerage looking for an experienced **Virtual Assistant with real estate compliance and transaction-management experience** to join our team.



This is **not a general administrative VA position**. We are specifically looking for someone who has worked with U.S. real estate contracts, transaction files, brokerage compliance, or transaction coordination.



## Our #1 Differentiator: Maryland REALTORS® Forms Experience



The strongest candidates will have previous experience working with **Maryland REALTORS® forms, Maryland real estate contracts, disclosures, addenda, and transaction-compliance requirements**.



If you have worked with Maryland real estate transactions before, please make that very clear in your application and describe exactly what you handled.



Candidates with strong U.S. real estate compliance or transaction-coordination experience but no Maryland experience may still apply, but **Maryland REALTORS® forms experience will be given priority**.



## Primary Responsibilities



You will assist our brokerage and management team with transaction and compliance-related work, including:



- Reviewing real estate transaction files for completeness

- Reviewing contracts, addenda, disclosures, and brokerage-required documents

- Identifying missing signatures, initials, dates, disclosures, or documentation

- Following transaction compliance checklists

- Organizing and maintaining digital transaction files

- Communicating with agents regarding missing or incomplete documentation

- Tracking outstanding compliance items

- Assisting with contract-to-close administrative workflows

- Maintaining accurate records and transaction status updates

- Uploading, organizing, and managing documents within our transaction-management systems

- Assisting brokerage staff with administrative and operational projects as needed



## Required Experience



We are especially interested in candidates who have previous experience with:



- Maryland REALTORS® forms

- Maryland residential real estate contracts

- U.S. residential real estate transactions

- Real estate contracts and transaction paperwork

- Brokerage compliance

- Transaction coordination

- Reviewing real estate files for completeness

- Working with real estate agents, brokers, transaction coordinators, or compliance departments



## Technology Experience



Experience with the following systems is helpful:



**Preferred:**

- Dotloop



**Bonus Experience:**

- Follow Up Boss

- Google Workspace / Google Drive

- Gmail

- CRM systems

- Transaction-management software

- Electronic signature platforms

- Real estate brokerage back-office systems



You do not need to know every system, but you should be comfortable learning new technology quickly.



## The Person We Are Looking For



You should be:



- Extremely detail-oriented

- Organized and process-driven

- Comfortable reviewing contracts and documents

- Able to follow detailed compliance checklists

- Comfortable communicating professionally with U.S.-based real estate agents

- Able to identify missing information and follow up until it is resolved

- Reliable and responsive

- Able to work independently

- Comfortable asking questions when something does not look correct

- Able to protect confidential client and transaction information



Strong written English and professional communication skills are important.



## Schedule



We are looking for someone interested in a **long-term position** with our organization.



Some overlap with **U.S. Eastern Time business hours** will be required.



Specific hours and schedule can be discussed based on experience and availability.



## How to Apply



Please do **not** send us a generic application.



**IMPORTANT: Put the phrase “Maryland Compliance” in the subject line or first sentence of your application.**



Applications that do not include this phrase may not be considered.



Please answer the following questions:



1. Have you worked with **Maryland REALTORS® forms or Maryland real estate contracts**? If yes, please explain which forms or transaction documents you worked with and what your responsibilities were.



2. How many years have you worked in U.S. real estate?



3. Have you previously worked for a U.S. real estate brokerage, real estate team, transaction coordinator, or compliance department? Please describe your role.



4. What experience do you have reviewing transaction files for compliance?



5. What types of real estate contracts, disclosures, addenda, or transaction documents have you reviewed?



6. Which real estate transaction-management systems have you used?

10. What hours are you available to work, and how much overlap can you provide with U.S. Eastern Time?



11. What monthly or hourly compensation are you seeking?



12. Please provide a brief paragraph explaining why your previous experience makes you a strong fit for this specific role.



## About the Opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted member of our team—not simply complete occasional VA tasks.



The right person will have the opportunity to learn our brokerage systems, become deeply involved in our transaction and compliance processes, and take on increasing responsibility over time.



If you already understand U.S. real estate transactions—and especially if you have experience with **Maryland REALTORS® forms and Maryland compliance workflows**—we would like to hear from you.

title: Senior Web Developer, Head of Web Development (AI + WordPress)
description:
Senior Web Developer, Head of Web Development (AI + WordPress)

Remote, Philippines | Full time, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern, Monday to Friday | $2,000 to $3,500 USD per month



ABOUT TIER3 MEDIA

Tier3 Media is a US digital marketing agency for medical aesthetics practices: med spas, dermatologists and plastic surgeons. We build and run their websites, SEO and paid media. Our fleet is more than 100 live client sites, most on WordPress, some of them a decade old.



THE ROLE

You will run web development at Tier3: the code, the platforms, the hosting and the developers. Most of all, you will lead our move to building websites with AI.



AI has changed how fast a good site can be built. One of our tests produced a full practice site in under 40 minutes, work that took about two days in the old page-builder workflow. We need someone to make that speed dependable: pages that look like the client and not like a template, that the next person can edit without breaking, on whatever platform the client needs. At the same time, 100+ legacy sites have to stay fast, secure and online. You own both.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

AI-built websites

- Build and rebuild client sites with AI every week, using agentic coders (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar), other LLMs, AI design and site generators, and MCP connectors.

- Own one documented AI build workflow that ships to WordPress (Elementor 4 or block themes), code-first sites (Next.js or Astro on Vercel) and GoHighLevel landing pages.

- Check AI output before it ships and keep the results editable by the people who maintain them.



Platforms and stack

- Pick the right platform for each client and write down why.

- Deliver a written stack recommendation, backed by a pilot, within your first 45 days.

- Keep all code and themes in git with staging and review.



WordPress fleet and legacy clients

- Keep every site fast, secure and online: updates, backups, monitoring, malware response.

- Fix recurring problems at the root.

- Maintain older builds (Elementor and other page builders, custom themes, plugins) without rebuilding what does not need it.

- Finish our hosting migration to WP Engine. Own DNS, Cloudflare, SSL and access, with every credential in a password manager.



Quality

- Write the definition of done and make sure every publish passes QA.

- Treat forms, lead routing, URLs and DNS as protected: staging first, written sign-off, tested before closing.

- Hold builds to Lighthouse mobile 90+ and WCAG 2.2 AA.



Leadership

- Lead two web developers now, plus a web support specialist once hired.

- Teach the AI workflow until each developer ships AI-assisted builds on their own.

- Run weekly one-on-ones, review code and give direct feedback.

- Work with our AI engineer and our Web Delivery Lead (who owns client scope and dates).



YOU ARE A FIT IF

- You build with AI every week and can show recordings of real builds on at least two platforms.

- You know WordPress deeply: themes, PHP, plugins, Elementor and other builders, block themes, hosting, migrations, DNS and security.

- You have shipped on code-first stacks (Next.js, Astro, Vercel) or headless CMSs and know when each is the right call.

- You use git, staging and code review by default.

- You have led or mentored developers.

- You can explain a technical tradeoff in plain English.



YOU ARE NOT A FIT IF

- Your AI experience is demos, not production sites.

- You know one tool and bend every project to fit it.

- You would rewrite every legacy site on a new stack.

- You would rather code alone than lead people.

- You skip QA when deadlines get tight.

- You are an agency owner, or can only work part time.



HOW TO APPLY

Send:

1. Your resume and/or LinkedIn profile.

2. Links to screen recordings (10 to 20 minutes each) of you building or rebuilding a real web page with AI, end to end, on at least two platforms, one of them WordPress. Loom or unlisted YouTube is fine.

3. A link to a git history you wrote (GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket).

4. Up to five sites you built or maintained, with your role and the dates.

Start your application with the words "AI BUILDER" so we know you read this far.



Applications without recordings will not be reviewed. We check the sites you list before any call.



OUR PROCESS

1. Review of your recordings and sites.

2. A 30 minute interview, same questions for every candidate.

3. A deeper second interview plus a paid 3 hour work sample. (Possible)

4. Reference calls, including someone who reported to you.
