title: Web Delivery Lead (Web and Dev Project Manager)
description:
Web Delivery Lead (Web and Dev Project Manager)

Remote, Philippines | Full time, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern, Monday to Friday | English C2 required



ABOUT TIER3 MEDIA

Tier3 Media is a US digital marketing agency for medical aesthetics practices: med spas, dermatologists and plastic surgeons. We build and run their websites, SEO and paid media, with a web fleet of more than 100 live client sites.



THE ROLE

You will own every web project from the day a client signs to the day the work is live and checked. You lead the people who build it: designers, a copywriter, a QA tester and a web support specialist. You work alongside our Head of Web Development, who owns how sites are built. You own what ships, when, and that the client always knows where things stand.



This is not a passive project manager role. You will not do the building yourself, but you need to understand the web development process from beginning to end well enough to problem solve with the team: spot why a task is stuck, ask the right technical question, weigh a fix with a developer, and make the call.



Our pipeline grew faster than the system behind it. Today a small edit can take weeks, and too many tasks wait in a queue without an owner or a date. We are also moving to an AI-assisted delivery process: call transcripts become a project brief, the brief splits into AI tasks and human tasks, and a person checks every risky step. You will run that process by hand while it is being built, so the load will be heavy for a while. We would rather you hear that now.



THE PROCESS YOU WILL RUN, END TO END

Discovery and kickoff, sitemap and content plan, SEO requirements, wireframes and design, copy, development, forms and CRM routing, QA and accessibility, launch (DNS, SSL, redirects, tracking), post-launch fixes, and ongoing edits and hosting. You should be able to explain what happens at each step, what usually goes wrong, and who fixes it.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Make sure every open web commitment has one owner, a next date and a clear definition of done.

- Solve problems with the team when work stalls: diagnose the blocker with the developer or designer, agree the fix and the date, and move on the same day.

- Assign every request within one business day, and get small edits closed in 5 business days or less.

- Lead the kickoff call for every new website build, send the brief back within two business days, and get the scope signed before work starts.

- Send every active client a written weekly update in plain English, with dates, so no client ever has to ask for status.

- Protect live client sites: nothing (forms, lead capture, URLs, pages) changes outside the approved scope without written sign-off.

- Close nothing without proof: a live link, a screenshot, or a test form submission landing in the CRM.

- Publish a short web scorecard every Monday that anyone in the company can read.

- Run weekly one-on-ones, give direct feedback, and hire our next QA tester.

- Keep every client login in the password manager, never in tasks or chat.



REQUIREMENTS

- English at C2 level (CEFR), spoken and written. You will lead US client calls and write to clients every week. Please include proof: a Cambridge C2 Proficiency certificate, an IELTS score of 8.5 or higher, or an EF SET score of 71 or higher. We also assess English live in every interview.

- A bachelor's degree, ideally in business, communications, marketing, IT, computer science or a related field. A PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum or similar certification is a plus.

- 4+ years leading web or digital delivery at an agency, with a delivery process you built and the numbers before and after.

- Experience leading people: coaching, giving hard feedback, and making staffing decisions.

- Hands-on use of AI in real delivery work, or experience delivering alongside people who build with it, and you can show how you catch its mistakes.

- Deep working knowledge of the full web development process, from discovery to launch to maintenance, so you can manage every moving part and problem solve with developers and designers. That includes WordPress and Elementor, page builders and themes, managed hosting, staging to live, forms and CRM routing, DNS and SSL, redirects, site speed, and launch checklists.

- A major plus: hands-on web development experience, SEO experience, or both (site structure, on-page SEO, redirects and migrations, technical SEO basics).

- ClickUp or a similar project management tool.

- Calm and organized when clients are upset and the queue is long.



YOU ARE NOT A FIT IF

- You manage by passing messages along and waiting. If you cannot follow a technical conversation with a developer, this seat is not for you.

- You would rather build than lead. If more than 30% of your ideal week is hands-on work, this seat will frustrate you.

- You prefer long sprints, ceremonies and change boards. We run same-day triage across many small sites.

- Your instinct on a small problem is a big change on a live site.

- You either avoid AI or trust its output without checking.

- You are an agency owner, or can only work part time.



HOW TO APPLY

Send:

1. Your resume or LinkedIn profile, including your degree and school.

2. Proof of C2 English (certificate or score report).

3. A recorded Loom video of 3 minutes or less, in English, introducing yourself as if you were opening a kickoff call with a new client.

4. A recording of 5 minutes or less showing an AI workflow you've used in real delivery work.

Start your application with the words "DELIVERY LEAD" so we know you read this far.



Applications without the English proof and both recordings will not be reviewed.



OUR PROCESS

1. Review of your application and recordings.

2. A recorded first interview of about 45 minutes, same questions for every candidate, including a short kickoff call role play.

3. A deeper second interview plus a paid 90 minute work sample.

4. Reference calls, including someone who reported to you.

title: Senior Funnel Developer & CRM Automation Specialist (GoHighLevel + HubSpot)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



Launch OS helps high-ticket businesses scale through marketing funnels and the systems that turn leads into qualified sales conversations.



We provide established funnel templates, design references, copy, and client brand assets. You adapt them into polished, responsive funnels and own the technical journey from lead capture through qualification, booking, follow-up, and sales-team handoff.



PAY & SCHEDULE



• Pay: $2,000-$3,000 USD/month, based on demonstrated skills and experience.



• Engagement: Remote contractor, based in the Philippines; 40 working hours/week.



• Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. Mountain Standard Time (MST, UTC-7), with a one-hour unpaid break each day.



• Time zone: Fixed MST year-round. In the Philippines, this is 11:00 p.m.-8:00 a.m. the following day.



WHAT YOU WILL BUILD



• Funnels: VSL, webinar, lead magnet, squeeze, challenge, sales letter, and high-ticket ascension funnels using our existing templates.



• Client adaptations: Apply supplied copy and brand assets with accurate spacing, typography, visual hierarchy, forms, and mobile layouts.



• CRM systems: Build GoHighLevel and HubSpot pipelines, custom fields/properties, tags, segmentation, lead assignment, calendars, and internal notifications.



• Follow-up: Implement
/SMS sequences, pre-call nurture, appointment reminders, and qualified-applicant/no-booking follow-up. Our copywriter supplies the copy.



• Appointment journeys: Handle bookings, reschedules, cancellations, no-shows, post-call follow-up, and post-sale handoffs. Stop or change messaging when a lead's status changes.



• ManyChat: Build lead capture, qualification, segmentation, and CRM or human handoff flows.



• Integrations: Connect forms, calendars, CRMs, and other tools through native integrations, APIs, webhooks, and Make or Zapier where appropriate.



• Tracking: Implement and validate lead sources, UTMs, conversion events, and CRM attribution across the lead-to-booking journey.



• Reliability: Maintain opt-outs and suppression logic, troubleshoot failed workflows and integrations, and document systems for ongoing maintenance.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Advanced GoHighLevel AND HubSpot experience, with examples of systems you personally built and managed.



• Production experience building ManyChat automations and connecting them to a CRM.



• Hands-on experience with Claude Code and OpenAI Codex for coding, debugging, and technical implementation. You can review generated changes, understand the underlying logic, and test the result.



• Strong HTML/CSS skills and practical JavaScript troubleshooting. You can adapt existing templates while preserving page quality, mobile responsiveness, usability, and loading speed.



• Experience with APIs, webhooks, and tools such as Make or Zapier, including field mapping, duplicate prevention, and troubleshooting failed connections.



• Strong automation logic: branching, enrollment and exit conditions, lead routing, appointment changes, and opt-out handling.



• Ability to implement and validate conversion tracking and source attribution. You understand how high-ticket funnels lead to qualified sales calls.



• Excellent spoken and written English. You explain technical decisions clearly, ask precise questions, and communicate comfortably on calls.



• Proven ability to work independently, quality-check your own work, document what you build, and deliver against agreed deadlines.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



• CRO and A/B testing, with examples of measurable funnel improvements.



• Git/version control and safe release or rollback practices for custom code.



• Domain/DNS and SSL setup,
 authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and deliverability troubleshooting.



OWNERSHIP & COMMUNICATION



We want someone who takes pride in winning for our clients and takes ownership from brief through launch.



• Anticipate problems, recommend solutions, and follow issues through to a tested resolution.



• Provide clear progress updates and raise blockers with a proposed next step.



• Flag risks before they become missed deadlines and communicate proactively during launches or urgent troubleshooting.



• Agree priorities, availability, and any additional hours and compensation together.



OUR QUALITY STANDARD



Your handoff should be ready for final business approval. You are accountable for checking your work and resolving defects in your deliverables.



• Check spacing, mobile layouts, links, forms, calendars, integrations, and tracking before handoff.



• Test complete user journeys, including duplicate submissions, changed appointment status, workflow exit conditions, and opt-outs.



• Deliver a polished build with clear documentation and completed QA.



AI SUPPORTS YOUR EXPERTISE



We use AI tools, including Claude Code and Codex, to improve execution. You must understand how a process works before automating it and be able to explain, test, and troubleshoot what you build without depending on AI. You remain responsible for the logic, implementation, and finished result.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Share two relevant funnel or automation examples and explain exactly what you personally built.



2. Include a brief video walkthrough in English of one system, explaining its logic and how you tested it. Use a demo or redact confidential client information.



3. Explain how you would handle a qualified applicant who hasn't booked, and what should happen when they book, reply, or opt out.



4. Summarize your experience with GoHighLevel, HubSpot, ManyChat, Claude Code, and Codex. Include your availability for the listed schedule and expected monthly USD compensation.

title: Head of Marketing
description:
Head of Marketing — Hüga Collective



**Location:** Remote

**Type:** Full-time



Why We Exist



Hüga Collective was built on a simple belief: home should feel like a place you exhale in. We design hygge-inspired lighting — paper lamps, floor lamps, table lamps, and candle warmers — for people who want their space to feel warmer, slower, and more like *them*. We're not selling light fixtures. We're selling the feeling of coming home.



We're a small, fast-moving DTC brand, and we're looking for a Head of Marketing to become the strategic force behind everything we do next.



The Role



You'll be the marketing strategist and operator for the entire brand — the person who connects the dots between what we make, how we talk about it, and how we grow. You'll set direction, lead a small creative team, and get hands-on with the channels that drive our growth:
 and performance.



This is a builder's role. You'll have real ownership and a direct line to the founder.



### What You'll Own



- **Marketing strategy** — Set the roadmap across acquisition, retention, and brand, and make the calls on where we invest our time and budget.

- **Team leadership** — Oversee and direct our video editors and content designer, keeping creative output aligned with strategy and on brand.

- *
 marketing** — Strategize and create flows and campaign strategy (we run on Klaviyo), working alongside our designer contractor to keep the calendar sharp and revenue-driving.

- **Performance & growth content** — Lead ideation for ad creative and performance content, working closely with our creative team to turn insights into content that converts.

- **Influencer marketing** — Oversee our influencer strategy, from identifying the right partners to managing relationships and turning collaborations into content that performs.

- **Brand stewardship** — Make sure everything we put into the world sounds and feels like Hüga — warm, intentional, never generic.



## What You Bring



- **6+ years** in digital marketing, with real ownership of strategy — not just execution

- Proven experience marketing for an **ecommerce brand** (DTC strongly preferred)

- A track record of **managing or directing a creative team** (video editors, designers, contractors)

- Fluency in *
 marketing** — flows, segmentation, campaign strategy (Klaviyo experience a plus)

- A sharp eye for **performance/growth ad content** — you can ideate concepts that are built to convert, not just look nice

- Experience running or overseeing **influencer marketing**, from partner sourcing to relationship management

- **Fluent English**, written and spoken — you'll be shaping our voice

- You think like an owner. You see the whole board — brand, growth, team — and you know how to move all three forward at once.



## Why Hüga



- A brand with a clear point of view and room for you to shape where it goes next

- Direct access to leadership — your strategy becomes the strategy

- A small team that moves fast and cares deeply about the craft

- The chance to build the marketing function from a real leadership seat, not inherit someone else's playbook



---



*Hüga Collective is a home lighting brand built on the idea that comfort is a form of care. If that resonates with you — and you're ready to lead — we'd love to hear from you.*

title: Personal Brand Content & Growth Manager
description:
PERSONAL BRAND CONTENT & GROWTH MANAGER



Full-Time | Remote | $5–$6/hour Based on Experience



I'm looking for someone to take ownership of the content and growth of my personal brand across 

YouTube,
, Instagram, TikTok, Shorts, and Reels.



This is NOT a basic social media posting position.



I don't need someone who just takes content, schedules it, and checks a box.



I need someone who understands content, attention, growth, hooks, storytelling, analytics, and repurposing — and can help turn the content I'm already creating into a much larger personal brand.



I already create long-form YouTube content and have a video editor. Your job is to help d
 what we should create, how we package it, how we distribute it, and what's actually working.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Content Strategy & Ideas



Research content ideas in my niche.



Study competitors and successful creators.



Come up with YouTube video concepts.



Help develop titles, hooks, and thumbnail concepts.



Identify topics with strong potential before we film them.



Look through existing content for ideas we can reuse or expand.



Repurposing



Review long-form YouTube videos and identify the best short-form moments.



Create/select clips for Shorts, Reels, TikTok, and
.



Write hooks, captions, headlines, and post copy.



Turn one long-form video into multiple pieces of content.



Adapt content for each platform instead of blindly posting the same thing everywhere.



Publishing & Management



Manage our content calendar.



Upload and publish content.



Optimize titles, descriptions, captions, hashtags, etc.



Make sure content is consistently going out across all platforms.



Help manage comments and community engagement.



Analytics & Growth



This is a BIG part of the position.



I want you looking at views, watch time, retention, CTR, subscriber/follower growth, which hooks perform, which topics perform, which Shorts/Reels generate traffic, and which platforms are actually producing results.



You should be able to tell me:



"This video worked because of X. This one failed because of Y. Here's what I think we should test next."



Not just:



"We posted 17 times this week."



TRACKING & REVENUE



We're not doing content just to get views.



I run businesses, software products, a community, and affiliate offers.



We'll use tracking links and UTMs where possible so we can understand which content and platforms are actually driving website traffic, leads, community members, software signups, affiliate revenue, and sales.



You don't need to be an analytics engineer, but you must care about the numbers.



YOU ARE NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR



You do NOT need to be my primary long-form video editor.



I already have an editor I really like.



Basic short-form editing is a big plus, though, and you should understand enough about editing to recognize what makes a good Short or Reel.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



You should understand YouTube and short-form content.



You should understand hooks and retention.



You should understand the differences between YouTube, Instagram,
, and TikTok.



You should be comfortable with analytics.



You should be able to research independently.



You should have strong English.



You should be proactive and bring ideas instead of waiting for instructions.



Most importantly, you should actually care whether the brand grows.



Experience managing a personal brand, entrepreneur, coach, creator, or business personality is strongly preferred.



HOW TO APPLY



Send me examples of accounts you've worked on and explain what YOU specifically did for those accounts.



Include any measurable growth or results you helped produce.



Tell me your favorite YouTube creator and why you think their content works.



Tell me what you would look at first if you were trying to grow my personal brand.



Start your application with:



"I know the difference between posting content and growing a brand."



If you don't include that sentence, I won't review the application.



PAY



$5–$6/hour based on experience.



Full-time position with room to grow significantly for the right person.

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Instagram Reels) - Model Content, Music + Text and Talking Clips,- CapCut - Full-Time, Remote
description:
Kakudai Media is a UK agency that runs Instagram for models.



You edit Instagram content of female models: fitness, fashion, swimwear and lifestyle clips, the kind you see on Instagram every day. No nudity. You must be 18 or over and comfortable with this kind of content.



THE WORK



You edit short vertical videos from raw phone clips our models film. There are two kinds, about half each.



1) Music reels (mostly 7 to 15 seconds)

- It is the model on camera, a trending sound, and one short line of text.

- You pick the best seconds, choose the sound, cut on the beat, and write the hook line.

- Outfit changes, before-and-after cuts, lip-syncs, get-ready-with-me, gym and lifestyle clips.



2) Talking reels (mostly 15 to 30 seconds)

- The model talks to the camera, usually from a short script.

- You cut out the pauses, put a hook in the first second, add accurate subtitles, and keep the pace up.



For both kinds:

- You make two or three different versions of a reel for testing: a different first frame, a different hook line, a different sound.

- You choose the cover frame.

- You deliver a clean file without the song, a preview with it, the name of the sound, and the hook text, in a shared folder, named the way we ask. Our posting side adds the sound inside Instagram.



WHAT THIS JOB IS NOT



- You do not post and you do not manage accounts.



HOW MUCH



About 10 to 15 new reels a day once you are up to speed, fewer in your first two weeks, plus quick versions of the best ones. We set the real number together in your first two weeks, based on how long the work takes you.



YOU WILL NEED



- Short edits you made yourself, of both kinds: a person on camera cut to music with text on screen, and a person talking with subtitles. Fashion, fitness, lifestyle or model content is ideal.

- CapCut on a computer. We pay for CapCut Pro.

- A feel for trends. You scroll Reels and TikTok every day, you notice a sound while it is still rising, and you can turn a trend around the same day.

- Good English. You write the hook lines, and your subtitles must match what is said, with no typos.

- You know what makes Instagram stop showing a reel to new people, and you flag a risky clip instead of using it. We give you our style guide and our list of words never to put on screen.

- Clean exports: 1080x1920, no borders, no app watermark, text where the buttons do not cover it.

- A computer that handles video smoothly, stable internet with a backup, and a plan for power cuts.

- You are reliable. If you are behind, you tell us before the deadline, not after.



THE DETAILS



- Pay: $4 to $5 an hour depending on skill, 48 hours a week (about $830 to $1,040 a month). Paid twice a month by bank transfer.

- Hours: 2:00pm to 11:00pm Philippine time, Monday to Saturday, with a one-hour break. A fixed shift, Sundays off.

- A paid two-week trial first, then full-time.

- Your rate is reviewed after three months.

- Long-term. We want someone for years, not weeks.



HOW TO APPLY



Answer all 9 points, in this order. Applications that skip a point are not read.



1. Start your message with the words "reel check".

2. Links to 3 short edits you made: two with NO talking (a person on camera, music, text on screen) and one where a person talks and you added the subtitles. One line each on exactly what you did.

3. Your editing software, and your computer (model and RAM).

4. Name two sounds that are trending on Reels this week, and say what kind of clip you would use each one for.

5. A model sends a 10-second clip of herself walking into the gym. Write three different hook lines you would put on screen. Keep each under 8 words.

6. Name three things that make Instagram stop showing a reel to new people.

7. Honestly: how many reels can you finish in an 8-hour day from clips we supply, if half are 10-second music reels and half are 20-second talking reels with subtitles?

8. Confirm three things: you are comfortable editing fitness, fashion and swimwear content of female models; you are 18 or over; and you can work 2:00pm to 11:00pm Philippine time, Monday to Saturday. Then tell us your expected hourly rate in US dollars and how you want to be paid.

9. Your internet provider and real upload speed, your backup if the internet goes down, and what you do if the power goes out.



Everyone who answers all 9 points gets a reply. We choose from your edits and your answers.

description:

About Us: 



We have been in business for over 10 years and operate a variety of eCommerce Shopify sites including Sun Tanning Store. We remain a growing eCommerce retailer specializing in retail and commercial tanning, wellness equipment, spray tanning and salon supplies. 



We also maintain a member loyalty program that allows spray tanning businesses to earn redeemable points on their solution orders and access deep discount codes that can be applied to orders to buy at wholesale price levels.  



Our diverse catalog of over 2,000 products includes high-ticket tanning beds, booths, red light therapy systems, tanning lamps, tanning bed acrylic, spray tanning equipment, tanning solutions, salon accessories and replacement parts. 



Because we deal with technical products and complex parts matching, we are looking for a sharp, meticulous, and reliable "all around" Operations Assistant to help run our back-office operations with our current team of staff.



What You Will Do (Key Responsibilities):



1. ⁠Logistics & Order Fulfillment: Monitor incoming orders on Shopify and submit completed Purchase Orders (POs) to our various manufacturers and vendors using
. Send template follow-up
s to customers notifying them of estimated shipping times and shipment inspection requirements.

2. ⁠Tracking Management: Retrieve tracking numbers and freight details from vendors, upload them accurately to Shopify, and trigger customer fulfillment notifications.

3. ⁠Data — Excel and Google Sheets Maintenance: Help maintain our master order tracking spreadsheets. You will log shipment tracking details and update order processing spreadsheets that include revenue, product cost, shipping costs, taxes, bank transaction processing fees, or discounts given to record precise product cost basis for assisting with our tax preparation.

4. ⁠Basic Website Management: Perform website updates and text adjustments in Shopify (we will provide step-by-step instructions or video training for this).

5. ⁠Vendor Communications: Help manage our operations inbox to handle basic administrative
s, vendor follow-ups, and backorder tracking. Note: This is a back-office role and you will not be speaking directly with customers on the phone. You will coordinate with other English-speaking staff to process
s within your capability.

6. ⁠Other back-office administrative support to help the business as needed and within your skill sets and capabilities.



Requirements & Skills:



1. ⁠Comfort navigating the Shopify backend (checking orders, processing partial/full fulfillments, updating product pages). Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills: you must be highly comfortable working with basic formulas, inputting numerical data accurately, calculating profit margins, and maintaining pristine spreadsheet organization.

2. ⁠Great attention to detail: correctly communicating Purchase Orders and identifying matching replacement parts (like acrylics or lamps) for specific tanning bed models requires accuracy and precision. Single-digit typos can cause many issues including highly expensive freight errors, angry customers, or payment chargebacks.

3. ⁠Communication: very good written English for professional
 correspondence with US-based suppliers and vendors.

4. ⁠Tech stack: reliable, high-speed internet connection with a backup power solution (UPS/generator) in case of local power interruptions.

5.) Self motivated and able to work independently without direct supervision, while staying communicative and coordinating closely with virtual team members.

6.) You’ll provide a copy of your Philippines ID, complete a W-8BEN, sign an NDA and pass a background check before hiring.



What We Offer:



1. ⁠Fun, stable company in business since 2011 with room to grow as we scale operations.

2. ⁠Reliable, on-time monthly payments via international bank transfer. 

3. Comprehensive in person and online and screen-recorded training (SOPs) and direct, supportive management.

4. ⁠Lenovo ThinkPad L14 Gen 7 laptop computer provided for use when conducting work for Meridian Shops LLC operating as Sun Tanning Store and other company owned websites. Please return the laptop and its original components when the contract ends.

5. ⁠Fully paid training trip to Manila — one to two weeks, transportation, hotel and meals covered, with hands-on training on the laptop we provide. Optional training stipend.



Hiring Process:



1. ⁠Resume review — we narrow applicants to a shortlist.

2. ⁠Online video interview, about 30-45 minutes.

3. ⁠Optional second interview of select candidates.

About Us:



Michaud CPAs is a U.S.-focused accounting and fractional CFO firm that provides outsourced accounting and financial management services to growing businesses.



We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented bookkeeper to join our remote accounting team. You will primarily support an established U.S. brewery business, working under the supervision of our Accounting Team Lead.



This position is ideal for someone who enjoys organized, accurate bookkeeping, understands accounting systems, and takes ownership of recurring daily and weekly responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities



1. Accounts Payable and Bookkeeping

- Verify invoice information, identify potential duplicates, and ensure proper expense coding.

- Maintain accurate accounts payable records and supporting documentation.

- Follow established AP procedures, including submitting exceptions for review.

- Record and categorize routine financial transactions.

- Assist with accounts receivable and other assigned bookkeeping activities.



2. Daily Accounting System Integration Monitoring

- Perform daily checks to ensure that accounting systems and integrated applications are synchronizing properly.

- Verify that expected transactions have transferred correctly between systems.

- Identify missing transactions, duplicate entries, failed integrations, and other synchronization discrepancies.

- Investigate routine issues and escalate complex problems to the accounting team.

- Maintain a daily checklist documenting completed integration checks and outstanding issues.



3. Reconciliations and Accounting Support

- Perform assigned routine bank, credit card, and other account reconciliations.

- Assist with monthly accounting schedules and documentation.

- Investigate and resolve routine discrepancies.

- Maintain organized accounting records and supporting documents.

- Assist the accounting team with additional bookkeeping tasks as needed.



Required Qualifications



- At least two years of professional bookkeeping experience.

- Experience with QuickBooks Online or comparable accounting software.

- Solid understanding of accounts payable, transaction coding, and basic accounting principles.

- Experience performing bank and credit card reconciliations.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

- Ability to work independently, follow established procedures, and meet recurring deadlines.



Preferred Qualifications



- Experience working with U.S. accounting firms or U.S.-based businesses.

- Experience monitoring accounting software integrations.

- Familiarity with businesses that manage inventory.

- Experience identifying and resolving accounting discrepancies.



Work Schedule and Compensation



- Approximately 15 hours per week.

- You must be available Monday through Friday to complete daily tasks.

- All working hours must fall between 7:00 AM and 12:00 noon U.S. Eastern Time.

- Compensation: $6–$8 USD per hour, depending on experience.

- Long-term opportunity with an established accounting firm.



Because this role includes daily accounting system monitoring, consistent weekday availability is essential.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Your résumé and a summary of your bookkeeping experience.

2. Your experience with QuickBooks Online and other accounting software.

3. A description of your accounts payable experience.

4. Whether you have previously worked with accounting software integrations and handled synchronization errors.

5. Your expected hourly rate.

You are reviewing the daily synchronization between two accounting systems. The integration indicates that it ran successfully, but you notice that some transactions are missing and others appear twice. What steps would you take?

About Us



Michaud CPAs is an accounting and fractional CFO firm providing outsourced accounting, financial reporting, and financial management services to growing U.S. businesses.

You will primarily support an established U.S. brewery business, working closely with our Accounting Team Lead and another bookkeeper.



This is a hands-on accounting position involving inventory accounting, account reconciliations, specialized excise tax reporting, and month-end close procedures.



We are looking for someone with strong accounting fundamentals who can work independently, investigate discrepancies, and take responsibility for completing assigned tasks accurately and on schedule.



Key Responsibilities



1. Inventory and Operational Accounting

- Prepare and review inventory reconciliations.

- Reconcile inventory records between operational systems and accounting software.

- Investigate inventory discrepancies and recommend adjustments.

- Assist with cost-of-goods-sold calculations and reconciliations.

- Prepare supporting schedules and journal entries.

- Identify unusual transactions and resolve accounting discrepancies.



2. Excise Tax and Regulatory Reporting

- Prepare recurring federal TTB excise tax calculations and filings relating to malt beverages, spirits, and wine/cider, as applicable.

- Prepare applicable Virginia ABC tax reports and related regulatory reporting.

- Reconcile tax calculations with inventory, production, and accounting records.

- Maintain accurate supporting schedules and documentation.

- Track filing deadlines and ensure that reports are prepared on time.

- Submit completed calculations and filing documentation for review and approval.



Previous experience with brewery excise tax reporting is an advantage but is not required. Training and established procedures will be provided.



This position does not involve preparing U.S. federal or state income tax returns.



3. Month-End Close and General Accounting

- Prepare assigned balance sheet reconciliations.

- Investigate and resolve differences between subsidiary records and general ledger balances.

- Prepare adjusting journal entries and supporting schedules.

- Assist with month-end accruals, prepayments, and other accounting adjustments.

- Support the Accounting Team Lead with monthly financial reporting.

- Maintain accurate records and complete assigned tasks according to the month-end close calendar.



4. Accounting Systems and Team Support

- Help investigate and resolve complex accounting system integration issues.

- Provide backup support for bookkeeping activities when necessary.

- Assist with reviewing transactions, researching discrepancies, and improving accounting processes.

- Maintain organized workpapers and clear documentation.

- Communicate proactively with the Accounting Team Lead regarding outstanding issues and approaching deadlines.



Required Qualifications



- Bachelor's degree in accounting or a related field.

- At least three years of professional accounting experience.

- Strong understanding of accrual accounting and financial statement preparation.

- Experience working with U.S.-based businesses or accounting firms.

- Demonstrated experience preparing account reconciliations and month-end journal entries.

- Experience with QuickBooks Online or comparable accounting software.

- Strong Microsoft Excel skills.

- Ability to investigate and independently resolve accounting discrepancies.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Excellent attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.



Preferred Qualifications

- Five or more years of relevant accounting experience.

- Experience with inventory accounting, manufacturing, or cost-of-goods-sold reconciliations.

- Experience preparing indirect tax, excise tax, or other recurring regulatory filings.

- Experience reconciling information between multiple accounting and operational systems.

- Experience working with breweries, manufacturers, or other inventory-intensive businesses.

- Philippine CPA qualification is an advantage but is not required.



Work Schedule and Compensation



- Approximately 15 hours per week.

- Working hours must fall between 7:00 AM and 12:00 noon U.S. Eastern Time.

- Some flexibility in the distribution of weekly hours may be required, particularly during month-end close and regulatory filing periods.

- Compensation: $9–$12 USD per hour, depending on experience.

- Long-term opportunity with an established accounting firm.



We are looking for someone who can commit to a consistent schedule and accommodate the heavier accounting workload that occurs during the first half of each month.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Your résumé and a summary of your accounting experience.

2. Your experience working with U.S. businesses or accounting firms.

3. A description of your month-end close and balance sheet reconciliation experience.

4. Any experience with inventory accounting, cost of goods sold, excise taxes, or regulatory reporting.

5. Your experience with accounting software and system integrations.

6. Your expected hourly rate and weekly availability.

7. Confirmation that you can work during the required U.S. Eastern Time hours.



**Please also answer the following questions:**



Question 1: During month-end close, the inventory balance in the general ledger does not agree with the inventory valuation report from an operational system. Explain how you would investigate the discrepancy.



Question 2: You are responsible for preparing a recurring excise tax filing. The current month's reported quantities are significantly different from the previous month. What steps would you take before finalizing the filing?

title: Warehouse & Order Fulfillment VA / Client support
description:
Warehouse & Order Fulfillment VA  (Full-Time)



To apply, start your message with the word BAGUETTE. Messages without it are ignored.



THE JOB IN ONE LINE

Every item we sell has to be registered with our warehouse the same day, or the parcel never ships and we lose the sale. That is your number one job, every day, before anything else.



WHAT YOU'LL DO, IN PRIORITY ORDER

1. Register every order with our warehouse the day it comes in — SKU, size, product sheet. Nothing gets skipped. If one order cannot be registered, you tell me the same day instead of moving on.

2. Log incoming supplier parcels: tracking number, contents, SKU.

3. Process outgoing orders: download shipping labels from our dashboard (DOTB) and create the shipment requests in the warehouse system.

4. Answer buyer messages that our auto-responder escalates, using ready-made reply templates that you adapt.

5. Handle disputes and returns (item not received, not as described) by following a written procedure. Escalate only what the procedure says to escalate — the rest is yours to solve.

6. Track returns so parcels actually make it back to the warehouse. This is where we lose the most money today.

7. Clean up old listings: rename titles, delete the ones that never sell.

8. Keep everything logged in a Google Sheet, and send me a short daily review every evening.



ABOUT THE BUSINESS

I buy fashion items and resell them on Vinted (a French second-hand marketplace) across several shops, with a fulfillment warehouse in Europe. The listings and photos are already handled by another assistant you'll work with directly. I need someone reliable on the operations side so I can focus on growth.



YOU NEED

- Good written English—we work in English. Buyer replies are in French, but you write them with ChatGPT or something else. No French needed; you just check the output makes sense.

- Reliable internet, quiet setup; available in a daily window overlapping the European afternoon (~1-7pm Paris time).

- Detail-oriented; comfortable with Google Sheets, web dashboards, and using ChatGPT.

- Calm and polite with unhappy customers; good judgment on when to escalate.

- Honest when you don't know something. I would far rather you ask me than guess — guessing costs real money here.

- Bonus: experience with Vinted, Depop, Poshmark, or e-commerce support.



HOW I WORK

- You get a written guide covering every task, plus video tutorials. You are not expected to figure it out alone.

- I answer questions fast. Ask me anything.

- Short daily review every evening: what you did, what is blocked, what you could not finish.

- Paid monthly, on time.



PAY

$
/month, full-time, reviewed after 1 month. 

Over time your salary can grow to 150 if the buisness also grow

IMPORTANT — MINIMUM EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENT

You must have at least 5 full years of hands-on, professional Google Ads experience. General digital marketing, social media management, SEO, virtual-assistant work, certifications, or occasional exposure to Google Ads do not count toward the five years. • Clear written English and reliable independent execution

• German/DACH campaign experience or German reading ability is a major advantage



Do not apply if your main background is social media management, content creation, SEO, general virtual assistance, or another field with only limited Google Ads exposure.



How to apply:

Begin your application with MANNHEIM. Answer every question directly and number your answers. Applications missing evidence or containing generic introductions will be skipped.



1. In what month and year did you begin managing Google Ads professionally?

2. During how many of the last 60 months was Google Ads a primary paid responsibility?

3. List at least five specific Google Ads accounts you personally managed. For each, provide the industry, target country, approximate monthly spend, dates managed, campaign types, objective, and your exact responsibility. Client names may be anonymized.

9. Attach anonymized or redacted dashboard screenshots, change-history evidence, reports, or a short Loom walkthrough demonstrating the accounts you managed and the results achieved. Never share passwords, login credentials, customer information, or confidential client data.

10. Confirm your weekly availability and expected hourly rate.



Claims and evidence will be checked during a live technical interview using a hypothetical account scenario. There is no paid trial task. This is a long-term position with direct access to the founder and clear responsibility for measurable results.

This is a hands-on sales role. You will be responsible for identifying potential customers, reaching out to them, starting conversations, presenting our services, and turning qualified prospects into paying clients.



We will provide clear service offerings, straightforward pricing structures, sales materials, and, where available, selected leads or contacts. However, you are expected to take ownership of your own outreach and actively build your own pipeline.



Our main target markets are the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada, with a particular focus on the US market.



Your Responsibilities

- Research and identify potential clients, primarily eCommerce businesses and online stores.

- Build and manage your own prospect list and sales pipeline.

- Conduct outbound sales through cold
, cold calling, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels.

- Contact provided leads and independently sourced prospects.

- Understand the prospect's business and identify relevant opportunities for our services.

- Present Valberg Commerce and Suppro.ae services clearly and professionally.

- Follow up consistently with prospects throughout the sales process.

- Schedule and conduct sales calls when appropriate.

- Prepare offers and guide prospects through the decision-making process.

- Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities with existing clients.

- Maintain accurate records of outreach, conversations, follow-ups, opportunities, and sales activities.

- Work closely with the internal team to ensure a smooth handover from sales to project delivery.

- Continuously test and improve outreach strategies, messaging, and prospecting methods.

- Consistently work toward agreed sales targets and KPIs.



What We're Looking For

- Previous experience in B2B sales, business development, lead generation, or outbound sales.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confident and professional communication skills.

- Comfortable making cold calls and starting conversations with businesses.

- Strong written communication for cold
 and LinkedIn outreach.

- Highly self-motivated and able to work independently.

- Comfortable researching companies and finding relevant decision-makers.

- Strong follow-up and organizational skills.

- Results-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership.

- Ability to handle rejection and remain consistent with outbound activity.

- Basic understanding of eCommerce and online businesses.

- Comfortable working with CRM systems, spreadsheets,
 tools, and other digital sales tools.

- You Don't Need to Be an eCommerce Expert



Our services are clearly structured and easy to understand, with defined pricing and service packages. You don't need to be a technical expert.



What matters most is that you can understand a client's situation, communicate the value of our services, and confidently move a sales conversation forward.



Nice to Have

- Experience selling services to eCommerce businesses.

- Experience with Shopify or other eCommerce platforms.

- Existing network or experience in the US market.

- Experience with cold calling and outbound prospecting.

- Experience using CRMs and sales automation tools.

- Experience selling digital marketing, web development, customer support, or other agency services.



Compensation



This is a fixed + commission-based position.



Fixed Compensation



We offer a small fixed monthly salary combined with performance-based commission.



When applying, please tell us what monthly fixed compensation you would expect.



Commission Structure



You will receive commission on both new business and additional revenue generated from existing clients:



15% commission on every new sale you close.

5% additional commission on revenue generated by that new client in the following month.

Commission on upsells and cross-sells with existing clients that you directly initiate and successfully close.

Additional performance bonuses may be available when agreed sales targets and KPIs are consistently achieved.



The commission structure applies to each new client you acquire, as well as qualifying additional sales you generate within the existing client base.



We believe strong sales performance should be rewarded accordingly. As your results and contribution to the company grow, there is room to increase your overall earning potential.



What We Offer

- Fully remote position.

- Flexible working arrangement.

- Fixed monthly compensation + attractive commission structure.

- Commission opportunities from both new clients and existing client upsells.

- Direct impact on your earning potential through your own sales performance.

- Access to company-provided leads and contacts when available.

- Clear service offerings and transparent pricing.

- International target markets, including the US, UK, and Canada.

- Opportunity to build and manage your own sales pipeline.

- Performance-based bonuses for consistently achieving targets.

- Opportunity to grow into a larger sales or business development role.

- Direct collaboration with an international team.

- Long-term opportunity within a growing eCommerce company.



How to Apply



If you're confident in sales, enjoy outbound prospecting, and want a role where your performance directly impacts your earning potential, we'd love to hear from you.



Please send us:



Your CV/Resume

title: Full-Stack SaaS Developer – Bubble + API Integrations + Workflow Automation
description:
We are building system, a simple SaaS platform for service-based businesses to create proposals, contracts, bookings, invoices/payment requests, and automated client follow-ups.



We already have the UI designs and detailed workflows. We need an experienced developer who can take the designs and build the complete working application.



This is not just a website design job. We need someone experienced with Bubble workflows, database architecture, calculations, APIs, responsive design, user accounts, and SaaS applications.



Core PayMe workflow



Business creates packages and add-ons → creates a proposal or event → enters client/event details → PayMe automatically calculates pricing → sends client a private link → client reviews → signs contract → PayMe redirects client to the business’s connected payment provider → client returns to PayMe → booking is confirmed → automated reminders are sent.



Important: PayMe does NOT process or hold customer funds. Payments are completed through the business’s connected payment processor such as Stripe.

•

• Automated client reminders

• Business settings

• Pricing and fee settings

• Responsive mobile experience



Automatic pricing rules



PayMe must automatically calculate pricing based on business settings, including:



• Start time + end time = total event hours

• Package minimum hours

• Hourly or flat-rate package pricing

• Additional hours

• Guest count

• Required staffing

• Example: 1 bartender included up to 60 guests; 61+ automatically adds an additional bartender

• Add-on pricing

• Mileage/travel fees

• Example: first 30 miles included, then configurable price per mile

• Gratuity/service charge

• Ability to choose which items gratuity applies to

• Sales tax

• Deposits — percentage or fixed amount

• Manual override when needed



Client booking flow



Public link:



Choose Package → Event Details → Optional Add-Ons → Review Pricing → Sign Contract → Continue to Payment Provider → Booking Confirmed



Private proposal:



Receive Proposal → Review Preselected Package → Confirm Event Details → Add-Ons → Review Pricing → Accept/Decline → Sign Contract → Continue to Payment Provider → Booking Confirmed



Payment integration



PayMe should never look like it is processing payments.



The client should see:



“Continue to Stripe”



followed by:



“You are leaving PayMe and will be redirected to Stripe to securely complete your payment. PayMe does not process or hold funds.”



After successful payment, the client should return to their PayMe booking page.



Automated client communication



• Initial booking/proposal link

• Deposit confirmation

• Final-balance reminder only when a balance remains

• Event reminder one day before

• Thank-you text one day after event

• Automatic Google Review link in the thank-you message



We want the system to be extremely simple for businesses and clients. Avoid unnecessary screens and settings.

• Strong 
 development experience

• SaaS application experience

• Bubble database architecture

• Backend workflows

• Conditional logic

• API Connector

• Stripe integration

• Webhooks

• Authentication and account permissions

•
/SMS automation

• Calendar integrations

• Experience debugging production applications



Experience with Twilio, Google Calendar, QuickBooks APIs, Make, n8n, or similar platforms is a plus.

3. Describe your Stripe/API integration experience

title: AI CREATIVE VIDEO EDITOR | PAID SOCIAL + DTC E-COMMERCE | FULL-TIME
description:
AI CREATIVE VIDEO EDITOR | PAID SOCIAL + DTC E-COMMERCE | FULL-TIME

Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term | $1,300 USD/month

We're looking for a full-time AI Creative Video Editor to join our team and help us produce high-performing paid social creatives for multiple DTC e-commerce brands.

This role sits at the intersection of:

AI + Video Editing + Direct Response + Creative Thinking

We're not looking for someone who simply waits for footage, follows instructions and exports a video.

We want an editor who can take a script, voiceover, product assets and creative reference and think:

"What is the strongest visual I can put here?"

"Can AI help me create a scene that doesn't exist?"

"How can I make this hook more attention-grabbing?"

"What can I change to make this creative stronger?"

If that sounds like how you naturally think, keep reading.

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

A large part of our creative production involves AI.

Traditional stock footage alone is not enough for the volume and types of ads we want to produce.

You'll be expected to combine:

- Real footage

- UGC

- Stock footage

- AI-generated images

- AI-generated video

- AI avatars

- Product assets

- Motion graphics

- B-roll

into complete advertising creatives.

AI should help you solve creative problems, not simply generate random clips.

OUR AI WORKFLOW

Our workflow includes tools such as:

- Higgsfield

- HeyGen

- ElevenLabs

- CapCut Desktop

- AI image generation tools

- AI video generation tools

- ChatGPT

- Google Drive

Experience with any of the following is also valuable:

- Kling

- Runway

- Veo

- Nano Banana

- Midjourney

- Premiere Pro

- After Effects

You do NOT need to know every platform.

What matters more is that you're comfortable learning new tools quickly and can figure out how to get the visual result you need.

We especially value experience with:

- Image-to-video

- Text-to-video

- AI B-roll

- AI avatars

- Lip sync

- AI voiceovers

- Prompting

- Character consistency

- Product visualization

- AI image generation

WHAT YOU'LL CREATE

You'll work primarily on paid advertising creatives, including:

- Meta /
 Ads

- Instagram Ads

- AI-generated video ads

- Direct-response ads

- UGC-style ads

- AI avatar ads

- VSL-style creatives

- Advertorial videos

- Product demonstrations

- Customer testimonial ads

- AI B-roll sequences

- Short-form creatives

- Longer 2–5+ minute ads

- Hook variations

- New versions of winning creatives

- Different CTAs and openings

- 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 formats

WE CARE ABOUT PERFORMANCE

A beautiful video that doesn't sell is not a successful ad.

We're looking for someone who understands concepts such as:

- Scroll stopping

- Hooks

- Curiosity

- Pacing

- Retention

- Pattern interrupts

- Problem agitation

- Storytelling

- Product mechanisms

- Benefits

- Social proof

- Testimonials

- Offers

- CTAs

- Creative testing

You should be able to look at a successful ad and understand WHY it works.

Not just:

"The editing looks good."

But:

"The hook creates curiosity."

"The problem is immediately recognizable."

"The pacing keeps attention."

"The mechanism gives the viewer a reason to believe."

"The proof reduces skepticism."

"The CTA gives the viewer a reason to act."

YOUR DAY-TO-DAY WORK

We will provide materials such as:

- Scripts

- Voiceovers

- Product assets

- UGC footage

- Brand assets

- Creative briefs

- Competitor references

- Winning ad references

You will then:

- Edit complete ads

- Source relevant B-roll

- Generate missing scenes with AI

- Create AI image/video assets

- Create AI avatar scenes when necessary

- Match visuals to the voiceover

- Add subtitles

- Add music and sound design

- Create pattern interrupts

- Create hook variations

- Rework winning creatives into new concepts

- Test different visual approaches

- Adapt creatives to different formats

- Keep project files organized

- Deliver editable files when required

CREATIVE AUTONOMY

At the beginning, you'll receive clear references and creative direction.

But over time, we expect you to become more independent.

If a script says:

"A man over 40 wakes up exhausted despite sleeping 8 hours"

we don't want to have to tell you:

"Use this exact shot at second 3.2."

We want you to be able to d
 whether the strongest execution is:

- UGC footage

- Stock footage

- An AI-generated scene

- An avatar

- A combination of multiple visuals

and execute it.

The stronger your creative judgment becomes, the more valuable you become to our team.

WINNING ADS & ITERATION

An important part of this role is creating new variations from ads that are already working.

For example, if we identify a winning creative, you may be asked to create:

- 5 new hooks

- 3 different openings

- New B-roll

- A new spokesperson

- An AI avatar version

- A UGC version

- Different pacing

- A new CTA

- A different visual concept

without destroying the core elements that made the original ad successful.

We want someone who understands the difference between:

COPYING a winner

and

ITERATING a winner.

LANGUAGE

Most of our advertising is in Italian.

You do NOT need to speak Italian.

We will provide Italian scripts, voiceovers and English translations whenever necessary.

Your responsibility is to understand the meaning and match the correct visuals to the message.

Italian subtitles and on-screen text will be provided.

You must copy Italian text exactly as provided and never independently rewrite or translate the copy.

Attention to detail is important.

WHO WE WANT

You may be a strong fit if you:

- Have experience editing e-commerce ads

- Understand paid social creative

- Understand direct-response marketing

- Have experience using AI creatively

- Enjoy testing new AI tools

- Have strong visual instincts

- Understand hooks and retention

- Can work quickly

- Can produce multiple variations

- Can follow references without blindly copying them

- Can work independently

- Are reliable

- Are organized

- Accept feedback well

- Meet deadlines

- Care about results

You don't need to be perfect at everything.

But you should be curious and willing to improve quickly.

THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

Please do not apply if:

- You only want to create cinematic videos

- You dislike AI tools

- You only want to work with footage provided to you

- You need detailed instructions for every single scene

- You mainly edit gaming, weddings or podcasts

- You have no interest in advertising psychology

- You don't care how your creatives perform

We're specifically looking for an editor interested in AI-powered performance advertising.

SCHEDULE

Full-time — 40 hours per week.

Fully remote.

Long-term position.

Some overlap with European working hours is preferred.

Reliability and consistent communication are important.

COMPENSATION

$1,300 USD/month — fixed salary

Full-time, 40 hours per week.

There will be a salary review after the first 90 days based on:

- Quality of work

- Speed

- Reliability

- Creative judgment

- Independence

- Growth in responsibilities

- Overall contribution to the team

PAID TEST

Candidates who pass the initial screening will be invited to complete a paid editing test.

We will provide:

- Script

- Voiceover

- Product assets

- Creative brief

- Competitor references

The test may involve:

- Editing one direct-response ad

- Creating different hooks

- Generating AI visuals

- Selecting appropriate B-roll

- Creating creative variations

We care more about your:

- Creative thinking

- Hook quality

- Visual choices

- Pacing

- AI skills

- Direct-response understanding

than fancy transitions.

HOW TO APPLY

All applications must be submitted through our application form:



The application takes approximately 10 minutes.

You will be asked about:

- Your video editing experience

- Your e-commerce advertising experience

- Your best ads

- Your AI experience

- Your availability

- Your current work situation

You will also be required to submit a 2–3 minute video introduction.

In the video, briefly tell us:

- Who you are

- Your editing experience

- Your experience with e-commerce ads

- The best ad you've edited

- Why you believe that ad worked

Applications without the video introduction will not be reviewed.

IMPORTANT

When the application asks:

"Why do you want this position?"

Start your answer with the word:

ORANGE

This lets us know you read the entire job description.

Applications sent directly through OnlineJobs messages without completing the form will not be reviewed.

We're looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of our creative team and grow alongside the company.

If you're excited about combining AI, direct response and video editing to create ads that actually perform, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Verification of Benefits (VOB) Representative – Behavioral Health
description:
**Company:** Claimwise Billing Solutions  

**Position:** Verification of Benefits (VOB) Representative  

**Industry:** Behavioral Health / Medical Billing



Claimwise Billing Solutions is looking for an experienced **Verification of Benefits (VOB) Representative** to join our team.



We provide billing and revenue cycle management services for **mental health (MH) and substance use disorder (SUD) providers and facilities** across multiple levels of care, including:



- Office Visits / Outpatient Services

- Outpatient (OP)

- Intensive Outpatient (IOP)

- Partial Hospitalization (PHP)

- Residential Treatment (RTC)

- Detox



### Primary Responsibilities



The VOB Representative will be responsible for verifying a patient's insurance benefits before admission or treatment. Responsibilities include:



- Contacting insurance companies to verify active coverage and behavioral health benefits

- Determining in-network and out-of-network benefits

- Verifying deductibles, copays, coinsurance, and out-of-pocket maximums

- Checking whether authorization or pre-certification is required

- Verifying coverage for specific levels of care and services

- Identifying behavioral health carve-outs and third-party administrators

- Using insurance payer portals to obtain eligibility and benefit information

- Calling insurance companies when portal information is unavailable or incomplete

- Accurately documenting benefit information for our clients and internal teams

- Communicating clearly with authorization and billing staff when additional follow-up is needed



### Required Qualifications



**Previous experience verifying insurance benefits is required.**



Applicants should also have:



- Experience calling insurance companies and speaking with payer representatives

- Experience using insurance portals such as Availity and other payer-specific portals

- Strong verbal English skills, as this position requires frequent phone calls with U.S. insurance companies

- Strong written English and documentation skills

- Good attention to detail and the ability to accurately record complex insurance benefit information

- Ability to work independently and follow established VOB procedures

- Reliable computer and internet access



### Preferred Experience



Experience with **mental health and substance use disorder insurance benefits** is strongly preferred, particularly experience verifying benefits for:



- Detox

- Residential Treatment

- PHP

- IOP

- Outpatient behavioral health services



Understanding behavioral health authorization requirements, carve-outs, and different levels of care would be a significant advantage.



### Additional Advantage



Experience with **insurance claim follow-up, claim status, denials, or accounts receivable (A/R)** is also a plus.



This is not required for the VOB position, but candidates who have experience with both **Verification of Benefits and claim follow-up** may have opportunities to take on additional responsibilities as the position grows.



### What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is experienced, dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable communicating with insurance companies throughout the day.



When applying, please briefly describe:



1. How many years of VOB or insurance verification experience you have

2. What types of insurance plans you have worked with

3. Whether you have experience with behavioral health, mental health, or substance use disorder benefits

4. Which insurance portals you have used

5. Whether you have experience with claim follow-up or insurance A/R

We need the complete package:

The "C" (Conscientiousness): Uncompromising standards. You do not give "sympathy passes." If an applicant fails to follow instructions, skims a requirement, or cuts a corner, you spot it immediately and disqualify them without hesitation.



If you love connecting with people but take genuine pride in clean data, strict gatekeeping, and flawless execution of standard operating procedures, this role was built for you.

title: PERFORMANCE VIDEO EDITOR | AI + E-COMMERCE ADS | FULL-TIME
description:
PERFORMANCE VIDEO EDITOR | AI + E-COMMERCE ADS | FULL-TIME

Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term | $1,300 USD/month

We're looking for a full-time Performance Video Editor to help us create high-performing paid social ads for multiple DTC e-commerce brands.

We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to edit videos.

We're looking for someone who combines:

Video Editing + Direct Response + Creative Thinking + AI

You should understand why an ad works, not just how to make it look good.

You do NOT need to know every AI platform we use.

What matters is that you're a strong editor, understand advertising creative, learn quickly and are comfortable using AI to create stronger visuals, better hooks, more engaging B-roll and more creative variations.

If that sounds like you, keep reading.

WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON

You'll primarily create paid social advertising creatives such as:

- Meta /
 Ads

- Instagram Ads

- Direct-response ads

- UGC-style ads

- VSL-style videos

- Advertorial videos

- Product-focused ads

- Customer testimonial ads

- AI-assisted creatives

- Short-form ads

- Longer 2–5+ minute videos

- Hook variations

- New versions of winning ads

- Different CTAs and openings

- 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 formats

Some creatives will use real footage.

Some will use UGC.

Some will use stock footage.

Some will use AI-generated content.

Many will combine multiple formats.

WHAT WE CARE ABOUT

We care about performance.

A video can look beautiful and still be a bad ad.

We're looking for someone who understands concepts such as:

- Hooks

- Scroll stopping

- Pacing

- Retention

- Pattern interrupts

- Curiosity

- Problem agitation

- Emotional storytelling

- Product mechanisms

- Benefits

- Social proof

- Testimonials

- Offers

- CTAs

- Creative testing

You should be able to look at a winning ad and understand WHY it works.

Not just:

"The editing looks good."

But:

"The hook creates curiosity."

"The problem is immediately clear."

"The pacing maintains attention."

"The mechanism gives the viewer a reason to believe."

"The proof builds trust."

"The CTA gives the viewer a reason to act."

AI IS PART OF OUR WORKFLOW

AI is becoming an important part of how we produce creative.

Our workflow may include tools such as:

- Higgsfield

- HeyGen

- ElevenLabs

- Kling

- Runway

- Veo

- Nano Banana

- ChatGPT

- CapCut Desktop

- AI image generation tools

- AI video generation tools

Experience with AI tools is strongly preferred.

However, we care more about your ability to learn and produce strong performance creative than experience with one specific platform.

You do NOT need to be an expert in every tool.

We want someone who is comfortable experimenting, learning quickly and using AI when it improves the final ad.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

You will receive materials such as:

- Scripts

- Voiceovers

- Product assets

- Brand assets

- UGC footage

- Competitor references

- Creative briefs

- Winning ad references

Your responsibilities will include:

- Editing complete video ads

- Finding relevant B-roll

- Matching visuals closely to the voiceover

- Generating AI scenes when useful

- Creating engaging subtitles

- Adding music and sound effects

- Creating visual pattern interrupts

- Creating multiple hook variations

- Iterating on winning creatives

- Testing different openings

- Testing different CTAs

- Testing different visual approaches

- Adapting videos into multiple formats

- Keeping project files organized

- Delivering editable project files when required

CREATIVE INDEPENDENCE

We will provide clear creative direction, especially at the beginning.

But over time, we expect you to become increasingly independent.

We don't want to tell you exactly what visual should appear every 3 seconds.

If the script describes a specific problem, situation or emotion, we want you to think about the strongest way to show it.

That could be:

- Real footage

- UGC

- Stock footage

- An AI-generated scene

- An avatar

- Product footage

- A combination of different visuals

We want someone who can make strong creative decisions instead of simply following instructions mechanically.

WINNING ADS & ITERATION

A major part of performance advertising is iteration.

When we find a winning creative, you may be asked to create:

- New hooks

- New openings

- New B-roll

- Different spokespersons

- Different pacing

- Different visual styles

- Different CTAs

- AI-assisted versions

- UGC-style versions

- New creative variations

You should understand how to create new versions without destroying the core idea that made the original ad successful.

LANGUAGE

Most of our advertisements are in Italian.

You do NOT need to speak Italian.

We will provide Italian scripts, voiceovers and English translations whenever necessary.

Your job is to understand the meaning of the message and choose or create the appropriate visuals.

Italian subtitles and on-screen text will be provided.

You must copy Italian text accurately and never independently rewrite or translate the copy.

Attention to detail is extremely important.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You'll probably be a strong fit if you:

- Have experience editing e-commerce ads

- Understand paid social creative

- Understand direct-response advertising

- Have strong visual instincts

- Understand hooks and retention

- Can create variations quickly

- Are comfortable with AI tools

- Learn new tools quickly

- Can follow references without blindly copying them

- Can work independently

- Are organized

- Are reliable

- Meet deadlines

- Respond well to feedback

- Care about performance

- Want to improve over time

You don't need to be perfect at everything.

But you should be curious, proactive and willing to improve quickly.

THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

Please do not apply if:

- You only want to create cinematic videos

- Your experience is mainly weddings, gaming or podcasts

- You are not interested in performance advertising

- You dislike learning new tools

- You need detailed instructions for every single scene

- You don't care how your ads perform

This role is specifically focused on performance creative for e-commerce brands.

SCHEDULE

Full-time — 40 hours per week.

Fully remote.

Long-term position.

Some overlap with European working hours is preferred.

Reliability, communication and consistent delivery are extremely important.

COMPENSATION

$1,300 USD/month — fixed salary

Full-time, 40 hours per week.

There will be a salary review after the first 90 days based on:

- Quality of work

- Speed

- Reliability

- Ability to work independently

- Creative judgment

- Growth in responsibilities

- Overall contribution to the team

Future salary increases will be based on performance and responsibilities.

PAID TEST

Candidates who pass the initial screening will be invited to complete a paid editing test.

We will provide:

- Script

- Voiceover

- Product assets

- Creative brief

- Competitor references

The test may involve:

- Editing one direct-response ad

- Creating different hooks

- Selecting B-roll

- Generating AI visuals where useful

- Creating creative variations

We care more about:

- Hook quality

- Visual choices

- Pacing

- Storytelling

- Creative thinking

- Direct-response understanding

- Ability to use AI intelligently

than fancy transitions.

HOW TO APPLY

All applications must be submitted through our application form:



The application takes approximately 10 minutes.

You will be asked about:

- Your video editing experience

- Your e-commerce advertising experience

- Your best previous ads

- Your experience with AI tools

- Your availability

- Your current work situation

You will also be required to submit a 2–3 minute video introduction.

In the video, briefly introduce yourself and tell us about:

- Your video editing experience

- Your experience with e-commerce ads

- The best ad you've edited

- Why you believe that ad was effective

Applications without the video introduction will not be reviewed.

IMPORTANT

When the application asks:

"Why do you want this position?"

Start your answer with the word:

ORANGE

This lets us know you read the entire job description.

Applications sent directly through OnlineJobs messages without completing the form will not be reviewed.

We're looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of our creative team and help us create performance ads that combine strong editing, direct-response thinking and modern AI tools.
