title: Senior Direct-Response Copywriter (Email, SMS & High-Ticket Funnels)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



Launch OS helps high-ticket businesses turn attention into qualified sales conversations. We are looking for a senior copywriter who can make the reader feel understood, communicate a believable transformation, build trust, and move them toward the right next step.



You will own
, SMS, webinar, VSL, and funnel copy for 6-8 clients at a time. Each client has a different audience, offer, and voice. Your writing should sound specific, natural, and credible while serving a clear conversion objective.



PAY & SCHEDULE



• Pay: $2,000-$3,000 USD/month, based on demonstrated skills and experience.



• Engagement: Remote contractor, based in the Philippines; 40 working hours/week.



• Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. Mountain Standard Time (MST, UTC-7), including a one-hour unpaid break each day.



• Time zone: Fixed MST year-round. In the Philippines, this is 11:00 p.m.-8:00 a.m. the following day.



WHAT YOU WILL WRITE



•
: Client newsletters, promotional campaigns, welcome and new-subscriber sequences, lead magnet follow-up, and nurture sequences.



• Booking and pre-call nurture: Application-started, qualified-but-not-booked, booked-call, reminder, and no-show follow-up copy that addresses hesitation and helps qualified leads take the next step.



• SMS: Short, conversational messages that invite replies, support bookings, and improve follow-through across call funnels, webinars, and challenges.



• Webinar and challenge campaigns: Registration pages, invitations, reminders, replay
s, follow-up, and genuine deadline-driven sales messaging.



• Funnel and landing-page copy: Complete pages for VSL, book-a-call, webinar, lead magnet, squeeze, challenge, sales letter, and high-ticket ascension funnels.



• VSL scripts: Clear, persuasive scripts that connect the audience's problem, desired outcome, offer, proof, objections, and next step.



FULL-PAGE COPY IS A CORE RESPONSIBILITY



We have established funnel templates. The developer may build a page using placeholders or an initial AI draft. You own the final copy and should be comfortable rewriting it completely when needed.



• Nail the cold-traffic hero: Make it immediately clear who the offer is for, what meaningful outcome it helps them achieve, why it is credible, and what to do next.



• Write the entire page: Headlines, subheads, body copy, benefits, proof, objections, FAQs, calls to action, form instructions, and confirmation messaging.



• Match the message across the traffic source, page,
s, SMS, and sales conversation.



• Review your copy in the actual page layout. Check mobile readability, awkward line breaks, button copy, and consistency before handoff.



HOW YOU APPROACH THE WORK



• Research before writing. Use client materials, customer language, interviews, reviews, sales-call insights, and available performance data to understand the audience and offer.



• Maintain a voice guide for each client: their tone, customer language, offers, proof, objections, and messaging boundaries.



• Connect transformation and nurture with sales. Help readers see a credible before-and-after, address uncertainty, build belief, and understand the next step.



• Use real proof and accurate offer details. Verify claims, testimonials, dates, links, pricing, and deadlines; flag missing evidence instead of inventing it.



• Give the developer clear copy, sequence order, audience conditions, and timing intent. Coordinate loading and in-platform copy revisions; the developer owns the technical automation.



• Maintain campaign calendars and priorities across 6-8 clients. Flag capacity conflicts early and deliver complete, self-edited work on time.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Proven direct-response and conversion copywriting experience for high-ticket offers, supported by complete landing pages and multi-message sequences you personally wrote.



• Strong understanding of transformational copy, nurture, and sales psychology: customer awareness, motivation, objections, proof, positioning, and calls to action.



• Ability to write both a strong cold-traffic hero and the full page beneath it. You can explain the purpose of each section and how it supports the conversion goal.



• Demonstrated
 and SMS experience. You understand the different formats and can write concise, natural messages without making every interaction feel like a sales pitch.



• Excellent written English and the ability to capture several distinct client voices. Your copy is clear, human, specific, and free of generic filler or inflated promises.



• Strong self-editing and quality control. You catch weak logic, repetition, unclear claims, factual errors, and mismatched calls to action before review.



• Proactive communication, reliable deadline management, and the ability to explain your decisions and act on feedback.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



• Agency or multi-client experience with high-ticket coaches, consultants, or service businesses.



• CRO and copy testing across landing pages,
 sequences, webinar campaigns, and sales-call funnels.



• Familiarity with GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and
 platforms for reviewing copy in context. ManyChat conversation writing is also valuable.



HOW WE MEASURE STRONG WORK



• Each client sounds like themselves, and the copy reflects their audience and offer.



• Pages and sequences arrive complete, accurate, and ready for final review; revision needs decrease as you learn each client.



• Campaigns ship on schedule, with clear communication and no avoidable copy bottlenecks.



• You use clicks, replies, opt-ins, qualified bookings, show rates, and downstream sales feedback to recommend focused tests and improve the message.



AI & ORIGINAL THINKING



AI can support research, ideation, and editing. You remain accountable for the strategy, accuracy, voice, originality, and finished copy.



You must understand the audience and offer yourself, develop your own ideas, explain your writing choices, and write or revise effectively without depending on AI to supply the thinking. An AI-generated first draft is an input for you to evaluate and improve.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Share one complete landing page and one
 or nurture sequence you personally wrote. Explain the audience, objective, and your exact contribution. Use samples you have permission to share or redact confidential details.



2. Explain one major copy decision in those samples and share performance results where available, with context about your contribution.



3. Describe how you would keep the voices, priorities, and deadlines of 6-8 clients organized.



4. Tell us how you use AI in your process and how you check the final work.



5. Include your availability and expected monthly USD compensation.

 — secondary. For founders more visible on social than LinkedIn

 via company websites — tertiary. Decision-maker
s sourced from company sites + enrichment tools

description:
Job Title:  Senior SEO, Web Ops & Social Search Strategist (Multi-Brand & SaaS) – Fast-Growing Role CDT



Company Overview:

We operate a high-growth portfolio of businesses in Middle Tennessee, including a corporate and ALE insurance relocation housing brand, an exclusive venue for retreats and private events, and a construction and real estate firm. *(Note: Exact brand names are kept confidential in this posting to prevent spam and will be shared with shortlisted candidates during the interview process).* We are also launching a new GoHighLevel-based SaaS company. Our infrastructure relies heavily on custom subdomains, government contracting pages, and automated funnels.



Role Overview:**

We are seeking an autonomous, senior-level SEO, Web Operations, and Social Search Strategist to take complete ownership of our organic visibility and technical web management. We are looking for a dedicated, long-term team member.



You will be managing our internal brands and handling technical onboarding/updates for our new SaaS clients. We need a dual-threat strategist who understands Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): executing deep technical site architecture inside GoHighLevel while systematically seeding social search and brand signals across platforms so AI engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI) actively recommend our businesses.



Adaptability & Growth Requirement:

Because we operate a fast-growing portfolio, things are always changing and evolving. You will frequently learn new systems and take on new types of tasks. Please note: your hourly baseline pay comprehensively covers all evolving responsibilities, ad-hoc tasks, and training periods. There is no additional pay for learning new skills or adapting to new operational requirements within your scheduled hours.



Compensation, Benefits & Uncapped Bonuses



*Base Pay:* $4.00 to $5.00 / hour. (Your starting rate will be determined by the experience and strategic depth you demonstrate during our messaging and vetting process).

*First-Month "Specialist Test" Bonus:* We are offering a one-time **$100.00 bonus** if four or more of our business websites are successfully audited and technically optimized within your first 30 days. This is our way of testing and rewarding a true specialist.

Long-Term Benefits:** As a long-term team member, you will receive a **$30/month health insurance (HMO) stipend** after 6 months of employment, and **13th-Month Pay** after 12 months.

Time Tracking:** Mandatory TimeProof tracking. All working hours must be logged using active desktop tracking with screenshot verification. Zero exceptions.

Monthly Performance Bonus:** Up to $100.00 USD extra every month, broken down into four clear $25 milestone targets:

15-Minute Response Time (+$25):* Immediate acknowledgement to all messages (Slack, WhatsApp, GoHighLevel) during scheduled shift hours.

Attendance & Punctuality (+$25):* Zero unexcused absences, zero missed meetings, 100% on-time arrival.

Task Speed & Turnaround (+$25):* All assigned technical tickets, client SaaS updates, and landing page audits completed on or ahead of deadline.

Core Search Metric KPIs (+$25):* Hitting monthly milestones (e.g., zero indexing errors, weekly GBP geo-tagged uploads).





Uncapped B2B Performance Bonuses (Targeting $8/hr Average):

Beyond your hourly base and monthly KPI bonuses, you will earn commission:



Tiered Ranking Bonus: $15.00 for every block of 5 primary commercial keywords (e.g., "Middle Tennessee corporate housing", "ALE insurance rentals") successfully maintained in the Top 3 organic positions on Google with lead flow.

* **Booked Lead Bonus:** $10.00 for every qualified B2B/corporate lead generated through your search and social efforts that successfully books with us. *(Note: This is a team effort—your role is to drive the highly targeted traffic and capture intent via our automated GoHighLevel funnels, and our internal team works to close the placement).*



*option to team partnership draw pay  at events and shows



**Key Focus Areas & Responsibilities**

* Maintain Core Web Vitals across all GoHighLevel pages (WebP compression, script optimization).

Social Search & Brand Authority:**

, Instagram) as search engines using keyword-rich bios, closed captions, and descriptive tags.

Application Requirements (READ CAREFULLY TO BE CONSIDERED)**

"Omni-Channel SEO for Multi-Brand Portfolio - Red"

title: Video Editor - Long and Short Form
description:
GENERAL PURPOSE OF JOB

Wheeler Home Concepts is a premium real estate photography and marketing company serving Delaware and the surrounding areas. We specialize in high-quality photography, video, digital media, and design services for realtors and businesses. Our reputation is built on excellence, creativity, and top-tier service.



We’re looking for a Video Editor to support our growing team with video editing, reels editing, long-form editing, ai video editing/generation, and other projects as needed. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly organized, and skilled in creative software tools.



Must provide a link to a portfolio of your work with your application. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.



ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.



Photography & Media Support

• MLS Real Estate Videos: Create cinematic style horizontal property videos for real estate..

• Photobooth Display Videos: Design and update photobooth overlays and templates, as needed.

• Reels Editing: Create short-form video content (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) using Premier Pro, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve.

• Long-form video editing: Interviews, podcasts, etc.

• AI Video Generation/Prompting: Use AI video generation tools to help bring creative and unique ideas to life to add to our video content.

• Assist with Writing and Maintaining Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs): Document processes and workflows to improve efficiency.

• Organization: Maintain organized records and files of images, projects, and updates in our system.



ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

• We hire for attitude and train for skill, but experience in general administrative tasks is helpful

• Must be able to work flexible hours; Ability to work with a sense of urgency when focusing on a task

• Communicate professionally in English, both verbally and in writing; comfortably interface with clients

• Ability to maintain a positive rapport with co-workers, Realtors, and clients a must

• Carry out duties in compliance with all state and federal regulations, codes and guidelines; Comply with all company policies and procedures

• Ability to perform repetitive tasks while maintaining speed of work and attention to detail without loss to production



Required Skills & Experience

• 2+ years of demonstrated experience with:

• Premier Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro (Reels/Video Editing)

• Adobe After Effects or similar motion graphics software

• Microsoft Office (Word, Excel)

• Must have a reliable computer capable of running the required applications and 4K60 video.

• Must have fast, reliable internet for remote collaboration.

• Good to excellent English skills (spoken & written) for communication, documentation, and team collaboration.

• Must be able to work 8am-Noon Monday-Saturday, Eastern Standard Time (4 hrs). There is potential for this to become a full-time job for the right candidate.



This is primarily a video editing role. Below are detailed descriptions of the skills required for this role.



--- Must-Have Skills (Absolute Needs) ---



Extreme File Organization & Project Archiving: Exceptional discipline in project folder structures, asset naming conventions, and systematic backup workflows. All raw footage, project files, assets, and final exports must be archived so any project can be re-opened instantly for client revisions.



Versatile Multi-Style Editing (Podcasts & Talking Heads): High versatility across formats—from fast-paced 9:16 short-form reels to multi-camera long-form podcast edits (multi-cam switching, speaker reframing, pacing, and audio balancing).



Multi-Project Daily Capacity & Rapid Execution: Proven ability to manage, prioritize, and deliver multiple video edits per day under tight real estate deadlines using proxy workflows, templates, keyboard shortcuts, and batch exporting.



Proactive Content Ideation & Simple Concepts: Ability to spot trending social media formats, identify viral hooks, and pitch simple, easy-to-execute content ideas that real estate agents can quickly film on camera.



Non-Linear Editing (NLE) Suite Mastery (Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve): Expert proficiency in at least one professional desktop NLE—Adobe Premiere Pro, Apple Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve—with a clean, standardized timeline and bin structure.



Manual Color Correction & Grading: Strong technical ability to manually color correct and grade footage using vectorscopes, waveform monitors, and primary/secondary color controls (e.g., Lumetri Color, DaVinci Color Page) to deliver accurate skin tones and true-to-life interior colors without relying on automated filters.



Complex Motion Captions & Typography: Mastery in creating dynamic, animated, and highly legible text overlays (word-by-word highlights, callouts, brand fonts) designed to retain viewer attention on talking-head clips.

Social Export & Encoding Standards: Thorough knowledge of optimal platform export settings (H.264/HEVC, optimal bitrates, frame rates, color spaces) to ensure fast rendering and crystal-clear playback across all major platforms.



Speed Ramping, Motion Tracking & Masking: Advanced technical proficiency in speed ramping (smooth velocity curves for walkthroughs and transitions), motion tracking (attaching captions, callouts, or graphics to moving subjects), and masking (custom reveals, subject isolation, and targeted color adjustments).



Professional Sound Design & Multi-Track Audio Mixing: Expert ability to clean up low-quality audio, remove room echoes/reverb, balance multi-mic podcast setups, level agent vocals against background tracks, and layer subtle sound effects (swooshes, impacts, risers, ambient fills) to make videos feel polished and high-energy.



Advanced AI Prompting & Standout Creative Generation: Proven ability to craft highly specific, sophisticated text, image, and video prompts across generative AI platforms (e.g., video diffusion, generative fill, expansion tools) to create unique, high-end visual effects, cinematic property extensions, and signature styles that stand out from standard AI templates.



--- Nice-to-Have Skills (Preferred Extras) ---



CapCut Desktop Proficiency: Ability to leverage CapCut Desktop for ultra-fast social edits, trending audio syncs, or rapid template builds when same-day turnaround is needed.



Motion Graphics (After Effects or Apple Motion): Experience creating or customizing lower thirds, animated property stats, transition overlays, or reusable graphics templates.



Real Estate Content Familiarity: Pre-existing understanding of property walkthrough flow, architectural framing, and real estate social media marketing trends.



All candidates offered an interview will need to perform a test edit and complete a color accuracy test.

title: amazon/online arbitrage sourcing
description:
EXPERIENCE REQUIRED.



Do NOT apply if you have never sourced profitable products for Amazon FBA before. I am specifically looking for someone who already understands Amazon product sourcing and can work independently.



You should already know how to analyze Amazon listings, research suppliers, verify websites, check sellers and competition, calculate profit, and determine whether a product is actually worth purchasing.



YOUR MAIN JOB



You must provide 5 VALID ASINs per day.



That equals 25 valid ASINs per week.



Finding 5 random products does NOT count. Products must meet ALL of my requirements and pass my review.



If some of your daily ASINs are rejected, you have until the end of the week/payday to replace them and reach the required 25 valid ASINs.



25 approved ASINs per week is the minimum requirement — not just 25 submissions.



BONUSES 💰



I reward VAs who consistently provide good leads and help me grow the business.



You can earn additional bonuses for:



Consistently finding valid ASINs: If your leads regularly pass my review and meet all requirements, you can receive performance bonuses.



More than 25 approved ASINs: If you finish your required 25 valid ASINs early and continue finding additional approved products, you can receive a bonus for exceeding your weekly target.



Finding profitable Amazon seller storefronts: If you discover a strong Online Arbitrage seller storefront that I can use for further product research, submit the storefront to me. If I review it and approve it as a good sourcing opportunity, you can receive a bonus.



High-quality sourcing: VAs who consistently find products that I actually purchase and successfully sell will have opportunities for additional bonuses and higher pay over time.



Quality still matters. Adding random ASINs just to go above 25 will NOT earn a bonus. Extra ASINs must meet the same requirements as your normal submissions and pass my review.



PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS



Every product you submit must:



Be a brand I am already approved/ungated to sell



Make at least $2 profit per unit



Have at least 50 estimated sales per month



NOT be a generic brand



Have realistic competition where I can actually get sales



Have enough room for me to enter the listing without immediately destroying the price



Come from a REAL, TRUSTWORTHY SOURCE



Be in stock and actually available to purchase



Match the EXACT Amazon product/variation



Include the correct source link



Include the correct Amazon ASIN/listing



Not already have been submitted by another VA on my team



ROI is NOT my main requirement. I care more about actual dollar profit, sales volume, competition, and whether I can realistically sell the inventory.



QUANTITY MATTERS



Do NOT submit deals that only become profitable when purchasing an unrealistic quantity.



Example:



If a product only meets my requirements when buying 25 units, but the Amazon listing only sells around 50 units per month and has 20 competing sellers, I am obviously not going to purchase 25 units.



Use common sense.



Look at:



Monthly sales + number of sellers + competition + minimum purchase quantity.



The deal needs to make sense for MY business, not just look profitable on a spreadsheet.



SOURCE VERIFICATION IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



You MUST verify every website before submitting it.



I recently had a VA provide a fake website that looked like a major retailer. A purchase was made from the website and the card information was compromised.



That cannot happen again.



Before submitting ANY unfamiliar website, verify that it is legitimate.



Do NOT submit:



Fake retailer websites



Scam websitesCopycat websites



Suspicious Shopify stores



Random websites with no established reputation



Sources you have not properly researched



A retailer/distributor different from the one you put in the spreadsheet



If you are unsure whether a source is legitimate, DO NOT SUBMIT IT. Ask me first.



QUALITY > RANDOM LEADS



I would rather receive 5 strong ASINs than 20 bad ones.



Do not fill the spreadsheet just to hit your number.



Repeatedly submitting products that clearly violate the requirements will result in termination.



YOU SHOULD ALREADY KNOW



You should have previous experience with:



Amazon Seller Central



Amazon FBA



Online Arbitrage



Product sourcing



Keepa



SellerAmp SAS or similar tools



Buy Box analysis



Sales rank / estimated monthly sales



Amazon fees



Profit calculations



Seller/competition analysis



Variation matching



Source verification



Checking whether Amazon is on the listing



Identifying dangerous price drops or listings with too much competition



Amazon seller storefront sourcing / storefront stalking



You should NOT need me to teach you the basics of Amazon sourcing.



HOURS



Monday–Friday

8 hours per day

40 hours per week



This is a long-term position for the right person.



Starting pay is $2/hour, but strong performance can earn you bonuses and opportunities for increased pay.



The better the products you find and the more value you bring to the business, the more opportunity you have to earn.



HOW TO APPLY



Do NOT send me a generic copy-and-paste application.



Start your application with:



“I HAVE AMAZON SOURCING EXPERIENCE”



Then answer these questions:



How long have you been sourcing products for Amazon?



Have you done Online Arbitrage before?



What sourcing tools have you used?



Do you know how to use Keepa? Explain what you normally check on a Keepa chart.



Do you know how to use SellerAmp SAS?



How do you determine whether there are too many sellers on a listing?



How do you verify that a sourcing website is legitimate?



How do you determine how many units of a product you would recommend buying?



What is the difference between profit and ROI?



Have you used Amazon seller storefronts to find additional profitable products? Explain your process.



Send an example of an Amazon sourcing spreadsheet you have worked with before, with any confidential client information removed.



FINAL TEST: Include one example ASIN + source link that you believe would be worth researching for Online Arbitrage. Briefly explain why you chose it.



If you cannot answer these questions, please do not apply.



I am looking for someone who already knows what they are doing, pays attention to details, follows instructions, verifies their sources, and can consistently find products that I can actually buy and sell.

title: QA Clinical Note Reviewer (Offshore)
description:
QA Clinical Note Reviewer (Offshore)



Department: Clinical Quality & Compliance

Company location: California, USA

Work location: Remote (Offshore)

Reports to: Director of Clinical Operations

Employment type: Full-time

Rate: $5/hr

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time (PT), aligned with our California-based clinical and compliance teams



Position Summary

We are a California-based organization seeking a detail-oriented Registered Nurse to serve as a QA Note Reviewer for wound care. You will review provider encounter notes for accuracy, completeness, and compliance, and make sure documentation supports medical necessity, meets payer and regulatory requirements, and is ready for billing and audit. You will work closely with the US-based clinical and compliance teams.



Key Responsibilities

Review wound care encounter notes (initial evaluations, follow-up visits, debridements, and advanced wound therapies) for completeness and accuracy.

Verify required clinical elements are documented, including:

Wound location, etiology, and type (e.g., diabetic foot ulcer, venous leg ulcer, pressure injury, arterial ulcer, surgical wound)

Measurements (length, width, depth), tissue type, drainage, odor, undermining and tunneling

Staging or classification (e.g., NPUAP/NPIAP stage, Wagner grade)

Wound progress and healing trajectory compared to prior visits

Treatment plan, offloading, compression, infection control, and patient education

Confirm that documentation supports medical necessity and aligns with applicable CMS guidelines, LCD/NCD requirements, and payer policies, particularly for debridement and skin substitute/cellular tissue product (CTP) applications.

Audit wound care notes against Billing and Coding Article A58565 (Wound and Ulcer Care), its parent LCD L38902, and LCD L36690 (Wound Application of CTPs, Lower Extremities) where applicable, and flag documentation that does not support coverage or correct coding.

Verify that CTP/skin substitute notes show:

Failed response to at least 4 weeks of documented standard wound care, including the specific interventions that were tried

Wound measurements at baseline, at the end of the 4-week period, and before each application

The other coverage criteria: wound size, clean granular base, adequate circulation, infection and osteomyelitis ruled out or resolved, diabetes diagnosis and management for DFUs, offloading or compression, and smoking cessation counseling where applicable

Check application limits and exclusions, including the cap on applications per wound episode, no simultaneous use of multiple products, retreatment restrictions, and contraindications such as uncontrolled diabetes or active infection.

Verify that debridement documentation matches the code billed (97597/97598/97602 vs.
), based on the deepest tissue level actually removed rather than the depth of the ulcer, and that procedure notes include the elements required by A58565.

Flag billing and coding errors covered by A58565, such as separately billing dressings, incorrect modifier use for multiple wounds, billing E/M with debridement without a separately identifiable service, and billing 97610 with other wound care codes on the same day.

Check consistency between the note, diagnosis codes (ICD-10), and procedure codes (CPT/HCPCS), and flag discrepancies.

Identify missing or contradictory information, copy-forward or cloned documentation, and unsupported conclusions.

Document findings in the QA tracking system using standardized scoring rubrics and error categories.

Return notes to providers or the clinical team with clear, professional, actionable feedback and follow up on corrections.

Meet daily and weekly productivity and accuracy targets.

Track error trends and contribute to regular reports on common documentation gaps and provider-level patterns.

Support internal and external audit preparation as needed.

Maintain strict confidentiality and follow HIPAA and company data security policies at all times.



Required Qualifications

Registered Nurse (RN) with a current, valid license.

At least 2 years of experience in clinical documentation and note review.

Strong working knowledge of wound care terminology, wound classification, and standard treatment protocols.

Familiarity with Medicare documentation requirements and medical necessity criteria.

Working proficiency in Billing and Coding Article A58565 (Wound and Ulcer Care) and its parent LCD L38902, including debridement coding rules, documentation requirements, covered diagnosis code groups, and utilization guidelines.

Ability to find and apply the current version of LCDs and billing articles through the CMS Medicare Coverage Database, and to stay current on revisions. Familiarity with other MAC wound care and skin substitute policies as applicable to the states we serve.

Availability to work 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time, Monday to Friday.

Proficiency with EHR systems and Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.

Reliable high-speed internet, a secure home workspace, and a company-compliant computer setup.



Preferred Qualifications

Working knowledge of LCD L36690 and skin substitute/CTP documentation requirements across multiple MACs.

Certification such as WCC, CWS, CPC, CCS, or CDIP.

Working knowledge of ICD-10-CM and CPT/HCPCS coding, including NCCI edits and modifiers.

Experience performing pre-bill or post-payment reviews on wound care services.

Experience with mobile wound care, home health, skilled nursing, or outpatient wound clinics.

Experience with RCM, audit, or compliance functions.

Prior experience working with US-based healthcare teams.



Skills and Competencies

Analytical thinking and sound clinical judgment

Clear, diplomatic communication when giving feedback to providers

Self-directed, dependable, and comfortable in a remote environment

Ability to learn changing payer rules and apply them consistently

Strong time management and prioritization

Performance Metrics

Notes reviewed per day or week

QA accuracy rate, measured through calibration and second-level audits

Turnaround time on reviews

Quality and clarity of feedback

Reduction in recurring documentation errors over time



What We Offer

Competitive salary, with performance incentives

Training in our documentation standards, tools, and compliance policies

Growth opportunities into senior QA, auditor, or clinical compliance roles

Collaborative, mission-driven team supporting wound care patients



Compliance Notice

This role involves access to protected health information (PHI). All employees must complete HIPAA training, sign confidentiality agreements, and pass a background check before starting.

title: Operations VA for a Music Educator (HubSpot, Outreach, Coaching Admin)
description:
I'm Glenn. I teach musicians how to get their music placed on TV shows and in films. I used to run a sync team at a major music company. I also compose for kids TV and run a paid coaching group.



My follow-ups slip. People wait on me. I need a partner who owns that problem, because my best work happens on coaching calls and in the studio.



What you'll own



A working HubSpot CRM. You build it. I approve it before it goes live.

25 outreach touches a week. You research and draft them, then queue them for me. You send the follow-ups I've approved.

Zero overdue follow-ups. You track every open loop.

A Friday report that shows who is warm, who is cooling, and what needs me.

Admin for my weekly coaching calls.



Results are what matter. I'll tell you what I need and by when. You choose how.



Authority



Improve the SOPs as you learn.

Flag problems before I see them.

Make small decisions inside the rules we set.



Requirements



4+ years supporting founders or executives

Built HubSpot workflows, not only entered data

Gmail and Google Workspace

Warm, clear writing that matches a voice

Experience writing SOPs

Async video updates (Loom)



Nice to have: Zapier or Make, Airtable or Trello, Skool, and music industry knowledge.



How to apply (all required)



Record a 2-minute Loom. Describe one CRM problem you fixed and how.

Start your message with the words "Steady Beat." I ask because I need someone who reads the whole post.

Include 2 writing samples and 2 references.



Finalists complete a paid work sample. The first week is a paid trial.
